# Senior E-Billing Coordinator

$70.5k - $107.55k

Ropes & Gray

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8597704636827094712?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2535747908908350042&crId=US_0US_0)

About Ropes & Gray

Ropes & Gray is a preeminent global law firm. The firm has been ranked in the top three on
About Ropes & Gray

Ropes & Gray is a preeminent global law firm. The firm has been ranked in the top three on The American Lawyer's prestigious A-List for eight consecutive years and #1 on Law.com's UK A-List twice in the past three years - rankings that honor the "best of the best" law firms.

The firm has approximately 2,500 lawyers and professionals serving clients in major centers of business, finance, technology, and government in Boston, Chicago, Dublin, Hong Kong, London, Los Angeles, New York, Paris, San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, Silicon Valley, Singapore, Tokyo and Washington, D.C.

The firm has consistently been recognized for its leading practices in many areas, including asset management, private equity, M&A, finance, real estate, tax, antitrust, life sciences, health care, intellectual property, litigation & enforcement, privacy & cybersecurity, and business restructuring.

Ropes & Gray is an equal opportunity employer.

Overview

The Senior E-Billing Coordinator plays a critical role in the revenue cycle of the firm by performing e-billing assistance on electronically billed matters such as but not limited to: monitoring and troubleshooting issues to ensure invoices are submitted successfully to our clients. The Senor E-Billing Coordinator should be familiar with the entire process including documentation, training, analysis, follow-up and reporting.

Responsibilities

The Senior E-Billing Coordinator is responsible for key phases of the e-billing process, including, rate uploads, follow-up on rejected items, and inventory tracking. The role also encompasses process documentation related to specific clients. The role specifically involves the following:

E-billing coordination between the firm, the e-billing vendor and the client, including all necessary setups and submission of preliminary data such as timekeeper and matter lists.
Accountable for his/her portfolio of clients. Senior E-Billing Coordinators are assigned to more complex and demanding clients. This role involves keeping all client & department spreadsheets and notes up to date.
Monthly review of assigned clients in which new timekeepers are identified. Assist with obtaining client approval for these newly assigned timekeepers on a monthly basis. On an annual basis, the Senior E-Billing Coordinator is responsible for the submission of an all inclusive rate card for each of his/her assigned clients.
Maintain the spreadsheets for new timekeepers assigned to each client and add them accordingly in the vendor sites for successful submission of invoices. This also entails mapping the timekeeper titles on the vendor sites whenever appropriate.
Help to identify reoccurring violations of client guidelines and alerting appropriate team on action steps.
Setting up of cost exceptions
Title mapping
Reoccurring timekeeper rate reductions
Formatting of LEDES file
Basic understanding of time & billing system in order to accurately identify resolution
Fully documents all aspects of the e-billing process for each client. Electronically stores all documentation so that it’s visible to billing management and staff.
Helps to maintain a database of all e-billed clients and their requirements for submission of bills. Also helps to maintain a database where yearly timekeeper rates are stored by client.
Utilizes E-billing Hub software or third party e-billing vendor websites to submit e-bills and conduct necessary follow up until invoices are accepted by the client. The Senior E-Billing Coordinator will work in the more difficult vendor sites and will be periodically asked to hold training sessions for the more junior team members.
Keeps invoice statuses current in the HUB; bi-weekly updates required.
Reviews e-bills for compliance with client/vendor terms. Fixes errors that will result in delays in uploading or rejection of the bill. The Senior E-Billing Coordinator is expected to handle the more difficult rejections and should be able to coordinate independently with the E-Billing HUB or specific vendor sites to troubleshoot issues.
Proactively makes recommendations and implements internal process improvements to maximize productivity and workflow in all aspects of the e-billing function. This includes working with Management to identify bottlenecks and streamline processes.
Works with Guidelines team & E-Billing HUB to ensure the proper invoice template is created according to the client/vendor specific guidelines. Able to step in and assist other team members when issues arise around templates and setups.
Works with Pricing team to develop and maintain rate cards for client submission. Creates a rapport with Pricing team members to foster a “one team” Finance Department approach.
Highly involved in team meetings and occasionally presents information to the broader group.
Conducts training sessions for other team members on a one on one basis and in group settings.
Collaborate with Billing team to provide an overview of E-Billing process.
Ability to run reports out of 3E and the E-Billing HUB
Provide recommendations to Billing counterparts & Management

Other Responsibilities

Participates in firm-wide and departmental projects and initiatives
Helps to train new members of the team as necessary
Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

Bachelors degree or higher in Business, Accounting or Finance is preferred or equivalent experience
Minimum three years experience with professional services time and billing software
Minimum three years experience in a professional services firm, preferably in a Finance department
Experience with various electronic billing systems. Should have a solid working knowledge of numerous vendor sites such as CounselLink, TyMetrix, Serengeti and others.
Demonstrated proficiency with MS Excel spreadsheets
Strong verbal, written, leadership, creative and interpersonal skills

Essential Capabilities

Demonstrates exemplary customer service
Must be a team player with strong interpersonal skills
Prioritizes, handles multiple tasks simultaneously and is flexible
Has a keen eye for detail and can readily identify issues that will slow a process
Demonstrates initiative and a consistent ability to identify and communicate opportunities to improve existing processes
Demonstrated analytical skills, strong critical thinking and ability to spot problem areas and propose solutions
Works independently, thorough and follows through on assigned projects and tasks
Works effectively with multi-office responsibility as well as a culturally and educationally diverse environment
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Compensation And Total Rewards Package

Ropes & Gray is proud to offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package to our business support team members. The firm also offers comprehensive health and well-being benefits, personal and professional development, career growth opportunities and a collegial and supportive culture. The anticipated pay range for this role is listed below and represents our good faith and reasonable estimate of the starting salary range at the time of posting. In addition, this role is eligible for a discretionary bonus based on performance. The actual offered rate for this position will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors, including qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data and consideration of internal equity.

Boston, Chicago, Washington, D.C, Los Angeles: $70,500 - $107,550
New York: $73,900 - $112,650

Working Conditions

This position requires hybrid on-site presence as an essential function of the role. Consistent and predictable on-site presence is required for ongoing business continuity, professional development and effective collaboration with colleagues and management.

Incumbent is expected to work the hours necessary to fulfill the responsibilities of the position. It is likely that this role will require more than standard hours during month and year-end closings and during special projects

**TYLin** is a globally recognized, full-service infrastructure consulting firm committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, constructible designs for the global infrastructure market. With over 3,000 employees throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe, the firm provides support on projects of varying size and complexity. Together, we enhance conventional designs with smarter, more resilient systems. We provide people with better mobility. We steward precious resources by finding more sustainable solutions.

**Job Summary**

TYLin is seeking a Senior Scheduler to work onsite at our client's location in San Francisco, CA.

**Responsibilities & Qualifications**

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

- Participate in logistical and delivery and work force planning with project personnel and incorporate into a CPM schedule using Primavera P6 Software.

- Review and provide comment on contractor prepared baseline, update and recovery schedules using Primavera P6 Software.

- Attend project progress and schedule meetings.

- Accurately track contractor work progress related to schedule.

- Maintain liaison with client and other consultants at all project stages.

- Identify improvements for schedule procedures, templates and products, and refer ideas to appropriate line manager.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**

- BS in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related field.

- 8+ years of construction project scheduling experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Understanding of construction scheduling processes preferred.

- Familiarity with and knowledge of Primavera P6 preferred.

- Certifications with PMI or AACEI is also preferable.

- Strong oral and written communication skills required.

- Proficiency with MS Office programs required.

- Client focused, always striving to give clients the best solutions.


**Additional Information**

TYLin is committed to pay equity. As part of that commitment, we have provided the base compensation range of $133,000 - $156,000 annually for this position and local market. We recognize that each candidate brings a unique set of skills, experience, education and competencies to the table that will be reflected in our offer. TYLin is proud to offer exciting career development opportunities.

**TYLin** offers a comprehensive total rewards package. Our benefits may include extensive medical, disability and life insurance coverage, continuing education benefits, paid time off, employee assistance program and a retirement savings plan with company matching contributions.

We encourage all candidates to explore our total rewards offering.

Collaboration, mission-driven focus, discipline, and leadership skills developed through military service benefit us all. Whether you are a Veteran, Guardsman or Reservist, a Military Spouse or you are planning to transition to civilian life in the near future, we welcome and value your application.

**TYLin** is an equal opportunity employer, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type as protected by federal, provincial, state or local laws. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. The company and its employees are required to comply with all local health authority, legal or lawful client requirements.

Enboarder

Role Overview We are seeking an elite, highly proactive Senior Executive Assistant to serve as a strategic partner to our C-Staff leadership. In a high-velocity enterprise ($50B+ revenue environment), your core mission is to act as an operational multiplier: architecting the executive’s time, managing complex global logistics, maintaining absolute discretion, and orchestrating seamless collaboration across our global executive administrative network.
You are not just managing a schedule—you are safeguarding executive capacity, predicting friction before it happens, and driving alignment across key internal and external stakeholders.
Core Responsibilities Strategic Calendar Architecture & Executive Time Defense Calendar Optimization: Design, audit, and aggressively protect the executive’s schedule, aligning daily time allocation directly with core quarterly business objectives, OKRs, and strategic priorities.
Proactive Gatekeeping: Act as the strategic filter for incoming meeting requests, triaging priority, context, and urgency to preserve deep-work focus blocks.
Meeting Preparation: Ensure the executive is 100% prepared for every engagement by sourcing pre-reads, agendas, and briefing materials 24–48 hours in advance.

# Senior Legal Operations Manager

$176k - $210k

Ripple Labs Inc.

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5743170024799047090?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6793233031981083754&crId=US_0US_0)

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

**THE WORK:**

We are seeking a Head of Legal Operations to design and scale the operational infrastructure of our global Legal Department. Reporting to the Deputy General Counsel, you will be the first dedicated legal operations hire in the organization. You will assess our current state, define our target operating model, and systematically build the processes and technology that will enable our legal, compliance, and policy functions to operate at the pace and scale that our business demands. You will bring strategic vision for developing a successful operations program as well as strong operational leadership and judgment.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

- Review, modify and enforce billing guidelines, manage billing, and drive cost rigor across external legal spend.
- Audit existing technology tools, identify gaps, and develop a multi-year legal technology roadmap covering matter management, CLM, e-billing, and AI-assisted workflows.
- Lead efforts that push automation, AI, and data-driven insights into how we deliver our work throughout the organization.
- Help drive the Legal Department's annual planning cycle, including budget, and headcount.
- Build a legal operations dashboard tracking matter volume, cycle times, contract turnaround, and outside counsel spend.
- Design, implement and be responsible for our suite of legal systems from legal intake process, templates and playbook library, and knowledge management system ensuring they're optimized, well-integrated, and aligned with business needs.
- Manage external vendors and consultants to ensure effective partnerships and strong ROI.
- Organize and manage key programs and events that support the day-to-day functioning and culture of the Legal Team, including Legal All Hands, Learning& Development resources, new hire onboarding, team onsites and other initiatives that foster team cohesion and professional growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

- 10+ years in legal operations experience
- Proven track record building or significantly transforming a legal operations function and a builder's mentality — this role requires writing the playbook, not following one
- Experience leading or supporting AI, automation, or data-driven transformation initiatives within a legal department
- Strong data and analytics skills

# Senior Administrative Coordinator

$25.87 - $32.31 per hour

Loyola Marymount University

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2389139774783727286?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7907918915584633249&crId=US_0US_0)

**Position Summary**

**The Senior Administrative Coordinator, Dean's Office** for the School of Film & Television (SFTV) reports to the Associate Dean of Operations and Administration and is a key member of the administrative staff supporting human resources, purchasing, and budget related processes with a focus on faculty searches, contracts, and compensation. This role acts as a liaison between the Dean's Office and the university's Human Resources department related to full-time, part-time, temporary faculty and staff. This role works closely with the Executive Assistant to the Dean and ensures accurate, timely, and confidential handling of HR-related matters. The Associate is expected to maintain the highest standards of discretion and integrity and support SFTV's commitment to efficient, compliant, and ethical personnel practices.

**Position Specific Responsibilities/Accountabilities**

- Serve as the primary staff lead in the Office of the Dean for oversight of all faculty and staff contracts and compensation including the preparation, submission, tracking, and maintenance of contracts.

- Coordinate the full-time faculty and staff recruitment process, including organizing search committee logistics, scheduling and coordinating interviews, assisting with meeting coordination, and collaborating closely with department chairs, Assistant and/or the Associate Dean for Faculty, the Dean and other university stakeholders.

- Serve as SFTV's designated liaison to LMU Human Resources for faculty contracts and compensation matters, ensuring alignment with university policies, procedures, and associated timelines.

- Function as a subject matter expert on HR-related processes within Workday, including hiring, contract generation, role adjustments, and other employee-related actions.

- Maintain advanced knowledge of general HR workflows including specific workflows and approval processes related to faculty contracts.

- Create and maintain employee directories and distributions lists, ensuring accurate and timely revisions year-round.

- Track, log, and process contracts, stipends and supplemental payments with precision.

- Meticulously review each transaction for accuracy before submitting and routing forward for formal approval from the Dean, Human Resources and necessary parties. Forecast delays and duration of approval process to avoid missing deadlines.

- Consult with the Office of the Provost as appropriate, to ensure required non-curricular administrative measures are completed in alignment with the faculty handbook and university guidelines in relation to pre-tenure, rank and tenure practices and processes.

- Demonstrate the highest level of confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive personnel matters and HR communications. Information may only be shared within the Dean's Office including the Executive Assistant, Associate Dean of Operations and Administration and/or other senior leadership at the explicit direction of the Dean.

- Support in the implementation of university-wide HR initiatives or policy changes, helping to communicate relevant updates to staff and faculty when appropriate and in consultation with the Executive Assistant to Dean and Associate Dean of Operations and Administration.

- Participate in SFTV and university-wide committees or working groups related to HR functions or systems as requested.

- Perform other duties related to Workday, TAP system, and/or employee compensation and payments.

- Submit purchases, conduct transactions, and process various invoices ensuring timely payment and accurate coding in accordance with university purchasing policies.

- Reconcile P-cards transactions and expense reports on behalf of the Dean and Associate Deans.

- Actively participate in finance, purchasing, and human resources related university hosted trainings and information sessions, staying knowledgeable on current processes and policies.

- Perform other administrative tasks for the Dean's Office including but not limited to fielding general inquiries via shared department inboxes, answering general office-line, updating SFTV directories, scheduling meetings, and coordinating catering, meals and travel.


Rank, Tenure & Promotions

- Maintain advanced knowledge of rank and tenure process, FSR process, part-time/term promotions, and related policies, procedures and criteria including timelines and submission deadlines. Maintain Box Files and master calendar.

- Main liaison between the Dean's office and the Provost's office regarding administration of faculty paperwork.

- Collaborate with Associate Dean of Faculty and Part-time/Term Committee Chairs or designated faculty member to ensure seamless facilitation and execution of action items, resulting in clear communication to faculty and successful submissions.

- Provide administrative support during, pre, and post promotions cycles.

- Create and maintain detailed records related to the status and nuances within individual contracts for faculty roles including tenure, tenure-track, and non-tenure roles.


Faculty Searches

- Serve as the main point of contact for the SFTV faculty search process. Support chairs, faculty, Assistant and Associate Deans with administrative and logistical support.

- Consult and collaborate with the Provost's Office and Human Resources departments to ensure all submissions are accurately processed, tracked, and shared within specified parameters, timeframes and deadlines.

- Complete administrative tasks associated with the search process including but not limited to the creation and maintenance of logs, rubrics, surveys, timelines, questionnaires, requisitions, job descriptions, job postings, and Workday submissions.

- Review, monitor, and maintain job postings and applications in Workday.

- Collect, gather, and organize documents and files from faculty, chairs, and applicants in designated BOX folders. Manage appropriate access levels and ensuring confidentiality.

- Develop email templates for correspondence related to faculty searches for both internal and external parties.

- Coordinate and plan logistical tasks including but not limited to catering and meals, itineraries, space reservations, space set-up/breakdown, teaching demonstrations, travel, lodging and transportation. Collaborate with various university departments such as Conferences and Event Services, Public Safety, and Transportation.

- Track and manage budget, expenses and reimbursements. Maintain knowledge of university purchasing policies. Consult SFTV Associate Dean of Operations and Administration on internal budget allocation.

- Coordinate and schedule in-person and virtual interviews, meetings and visits, accounting for holidays, SFTV and university schedule. Consult the Executive Assistant to the Dean to forecast and confirm Dean participation.

- Attend required Recruitment and Hiring trainings including but not limited to DEI initiatives and Human Resources. Facilitate internal trainings and/or distribution of guides, resources and toolkits to SFTV chairs, faculty, and search committees as applicable.


Faculty Grants and Fellowships

- In collaboration with the Assistant and/or Associate Dean of Faculty, communicate and track faculty grants and fellowships.

- Maintain timeline of action items, submission details, deadlines and BOX folders.

- Draft email communications, ensuring they are accurate and comprehensive.

- Consult with the Associate Dean of Operations and Administration and/or designated Academic Affairs Budget staff to execute system transactions and ensure advanced understanding of fiscal year deadlines, parameters of funds, and faculty payment options.

- Maintain accurate records of awardees, award parameters, and payment processing.


Policy & Procedures

- Build and maintain strong partnerships with centralized university HR department, Provost's office and designated personnel. Seek out clarity and guidance and document standard operating procedures to supplement existing written Human Resources, Purchasing, and Finance related policies and practices.

- Create and maintain detailed guides, manuals, historical records, and resource documents to ensure processes are outlined specific to SFTV and keep current.

- Maintain detailed records, correspondence, and documentation in a secure and compliant manner. Store documents, spreadsheets and electronic materials within the designated electronic folders, strictly aligned with SFTV criteria regarding document storing, access, and confidentially practices.


Faculty & Staff Support

- Communicate with faculty members individually providing accurate information related to the processing of their contracts, stipends, or misc. payments. Ensuring other faculty inquiries and support requests are referred or routed to applicable chairs, faculty services staff and/or the Assistant and/or Associate Dean of Faculty.

- Regularly monitor the status of HR submissions and follow up with Human Resources and relevant parties to ensure smooth, on-time processing.

- In consultation with the Associate Dean of Operations and Administration, provide guidance and support to SFTV staff on how to initiate and submit HR-related tasks in Workday, serving as an internal resource for system navigation and best practices.


**Loyola Marymount University Expectations**

Exhibit behavior that supports the mission, vision, and values of the university. Communicate and employ interpersonal actions that model high standards of professional, responsible, accountable, and ethical conduct. Demonstrate a commitment to outstanding customer service.

**Requisition Qualifications**

- Typically a bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field or equivalent experience.

- Minimum of 4 years of experience in human resources administration, personnel coordination, or higher education support roles. University experience preferred.

- Demonstrated knowledge of HR

### Job Description

Job Description

Description:

**Position Summary**

This role supports the finance team in maintaining accurate financial records and performing general accounting functions. This position will also provide light HR administration support, assisting with basic onboarding tasks and maintaining employee records.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

- Perform daily, weekly, and monthly cash reconciliations to ensure accuracy and integrity of financial data, cash balance tracking, and bank deposit downloads.
- Maintain general ledger accuracy and ensure alignment with all financial accounts.
- Perform full-cycle accounts payable and accounts receivable functions weekly, including invoice data entry, routing approval, payments, create invoices, and follow-up payment posting and reconciliation.
- Generate and submit reports and census data for audits, compliance, and internal projects.
- Maintain and coordinate filing systems with the patient billing company to ensure accurate financial records.
- Process multiple payrolls, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and policies. Coordinate with department payroll managers, including timesheet verification and submission. Including digital record keeping.
- Enter and maintain employee changes and wage garnishments in the payroll system.
- Assist with employee benefits enrollments, tracking, and updates.
- Support HR and Finance teams with administrative tasks and special projects as needed.
- Other duties as assigned.

**Other Responsibilities**

- Attend regular meetings or training seminars, as required.
- Maintain compliance with all company policies and practices.
- Collaborate with cross-functional staff to support shared initiatives and resolve issues.
- Provide courteous and professional support to staff inquiries.
- Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**Education, Experience and Skills**

**Personal Qualities:**

- Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to meet multiple deadlines.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in handling structured data and documentation.
- Capable of tracking processes, maintaining records, and leading projects to completion.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.

**Education** :

- Associate or bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience in accounting role required.

**Work Experience:**

- 2 years of accounting and administrative support experience required.
- Experience in healthcare, physician group, or multi-entity organization preferred.
- Familiarity with GAAP and basic financial reporting required.

**Equipment:**

- Comfortable use of office equipment such as computers, copies, and fax machines.

**Computer Skills** :

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc.).
- Accurate data entry and efficient keyboarding skills.

**Platform Knowledge:**

- Working knowledge of payroll systems and HRIS platforms (e.g., Paylocity or similar).
- Experience with accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks or comparable systems).

##### Senior Billing Specialist

A leading law firm is seeking a Senior Billing Specialist for its Century City office. This role partners closely with the Billing Manager, attorneys, clients, and other members of the Billing Department to manage the preparation, review, and submission of a high volume of monthly prebills and invoices, while also supporting complex billing matters, e-billing processes, client billing requirements, rate maintenance, and the resolution of billing-related issues. The Senior Billing Specialist oversees the prebill process from issuance through completion, tracking outstanding prebills and following up with attorneys to keep invoice submission on schedule. The role also manages multiple billing addresses, split bills, multi-payer matters, and consolidated or multi-matter billing, along with e-billing setup, rate submission and tracking, and the approval process. Additional responsibilities include investigating and appealing e-billing rejections, maintaining accurate client and matter billing information within the firm's billing system, supporting the Billing Manager on departmental operations and special projects, and providing responsive service to attorneys and clients.

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of legal billing experience in a law firm environment; experience with Aderant, Elite, or a comparable billing system is preferred, along with proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook. The salary range is $95,000–$105,000.

# Sr. Marketing Specialist

$88k - $130k

Gilbane Building Co

[Pico Rivera, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Pico-Rivera%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3548064738626356755?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6590&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8844714193638738900&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Sr. Marketing Specialist

Job Locations

US-CA-Sacramento \| US-CA-San Jose \| US-AZ-Phoenix \| US-CA-Los Angeles






Requisition ID

2026-13338



Category

Marketing and Proposal Support




































##### Overview

Gilbane Building Company is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Marketing Specialist to join our West Division, based in either Los Angeles, Sacramento, San Jose or Phoenix. This high-impact role is ideal for a forward-thinking strategic, creative professional who thrives in a collaborative environment to translate business objectives into compelling deliverables for our clients. With significant autonomy, you will lead the development of client-focused proposals, qualifications, and presentations that reflect Gilbane's brand and value proposition. As a key partner to business development, you'll shape campaigns, elevate market visibility, and craft narratives that differentiate Gilbane in a competitive landscape. A consistent and visible presence in either office is essential to build strong team connections, deepen market understanding, and drive initiatives that support local growth and client engagement.

**This role will sit primarily in the office.**

**Who are we?**

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

**Who are you?**

You are someone who acts inclusively, showing empathy and treating others with respect and dignity in order to uphold Gilbane's core value of Caring and "People First" workplace culture. You seek to listen in order to understand and can convey information clearly. You're a strong problem solver who can identify, prioritize, and implement alternatives for solutions, and you demonstrate adaptability by collaborating with others and supporting team members to achieve excellence. A self-starter who shows passion, commitment, and ownership all while delivering on business outcomes and driving results. You're someone who identifies opportunities for new and improved ways of doing things that result in value-add solutions.

_Your core values match Gilbane's: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship._

**What's in it for you?**

Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to projects, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you would work with an experienced team which provides you with the opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

##### Responsibilities

Leads the development and production of client qualifications, proposals, and presentations with a focus on quality, creativity, and meeting client deadlines independently - Manages content development and pursuits process directly with the Business Development (BD) team
- Crafts compelling story content about clients, projects, people, and Gilbane and incorporates these differentiators into deliverables that address the unique client needs
- Ensures all external content and client deliverables align with Gilbane's brand standards and messaging guidelines
- Participates in presell meetings and strategic brainstorms
- Leads the development and execution of marketing campaigns, branded content, awards and speaking submissions, and local event support to increase Gilbane's market visibility
- Leads the development of internal and external communications including newsletters, press releases, website content, social media posts, eblasts, and content for other digital channels
- Oversees the organization and maintenance of digital assets, ensuring efficient categorization and searchability while providing guidance and support to entry-level team members
- Leads data maintenance for assigned geography to ensure data integrity
- Conducts research for the different market sectors to understand our clients including who they are, what's top of mind and key trends; analyzes, interprets, and communicates research with BD partners and local leadership as needed
- Leads close-out process of sales and marketing deliverables
- Develops a strong knowledge of the AEC industry and Gilbane's capabilities across each sector, locally and nationally
- Builds and maintains a robust operational network to facilitate storytelling and identify value adds about our projects
- Visits jobsites regularly to enhance operational partnerships, take photos, and interview project teams for future content opportunities; ensures content is organized and cataloged for future use
- Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality external content and client deliverables, ensuring clear communication, mutual support, and a cohesive approach to problem-solving
- Mentors, coaches, and trains less experienced team members
- Leads multiple deliverables concurrently and has a strong ability to multi-task independently
- Participates in professional or community organizations and begins to explore opportunities for committee or other leadership opportunities
- Stays abreast of new marcom trends and tools
- Supports a positive and inclusive work environment

##### Qualifications

**EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION**

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
- 5-7 years relevant experience in the marketing and/or AEC industry
- Or equivalent combination of education and experience

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES**

- Advanced knowledge and skills in Adobe Creative Suite (primarily InDesign), Power Point, Unanet (or other CRM database), and Photography
- Excellent time management, organization, and communication skills
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team
- Advanced writing and critical thinking skills
- Strong knowledge and skills in process management
- Strong knowledge of Gilbane services and advanced knowledge of construction management and industry awareness as a whole

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

For **Phoenix, AZ** , this ranges from $88,000 - $130,000 plus benefits and retirement program.

For **Sacramento, CA** , this ranges from $100,000 - $145,000 plus benefits and retirement program.

For **Los Angeles, CA** , this ranges from $110,000 - $155,000 plus benefits and retirement program.

For **San Jose, CA** , this ranges from $118,000 - $165,000 plus benefits and retirement program.

_Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees' education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry. Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test._

_Gilbane is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or disability status._

_**Note to Recruiters, Placement Agencies, and Similar Organizations** : Gilbane does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our jobs alias, website, or to any Gilbane employee. Gilbane will not pay fees to any third party agency or firm and will not be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. Unsolicited resumes received will be considered property of Gilbane and will be processed accordingly._

The Senior E-Billing Coordinator is an integral part of Latham's Global Finance team and will be responsible for the submission of electronic invoices to clients on a monthly basis, overseeing the transition of clients to e-billing, and providing follow-up support to attorneys, practice office staff, and clients in all aspects related to electronic billing, as well as handling a heavy volume of highly complex e-submission assignments for key corporate clients and ensuring that all client guidelines, internal protocols, and firm guidelines are followed during the submission process. This role will be located in either our Global Satellite Office in Downtown Los Angeles, San Diego, Silicon Valley, San Francisco, or Orange County office. Please note that this role may be eligible for a flexible working schedule that allows for a hybrid and in-office presence.

Other key responsibilities include:

- Acting as a liaison between billing attorney/secretarial staff, practice office billing staff, and clients' staff assigned to electronic billing by providing expert-level subject matter support
- Liaising with billing attorney/secretary, practice office accounting staff, and client representatives in the resubmission of invoices and ensuring corrective action is in place for future submissions
- Populating, maintaining, and updating data for assigned clients in the 3E system and clients' external web applications, while also ensuring all relevant information is updated and correlated in the firm's 3E system
- Performing necessary technical and logistical tasks with internal staff, vendor staff, and clients' designated personnel in the transition of clients to electronic billing
- Working collaboratively with the department's supervisor to support e-billing systems by adding/removing user accounts, resetting passwords, assigning proper security levels, entering budgets, status reports, and matter profiles in various sub-systems
- Protecting and maintaining any highly sensitive, confidential, privileged, financial, and/or proprietary information that Latham & Watkins retains

We'd love to hear from you if you:

- Possess knowledge and experience with web-based e-billing systems and vendors (e.g., Serengeti, Datacert, Tymetrix)
- Demonstrate the ability to test and troubleshoot multiple e-software applications, summarize findings, and identify potential problem areas
- Display the ability to work with LEDES formats

And have:

- A high school diploma or equivalent, preferably a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or another related field
- A minimum of two (2) years of experience with the 3E Billing system
- A minimum of two (2) years of experience with E-billing vendors
- A minimum of five (5) years of experience involving general accounting practices
- A minimum of four (4) years of experience involving billing processes and practices
- Knowledge of 3E's E-Invoicing module, preferably

##### Benefits & Additional Information

Successful candidates will not only be provided with an outstanding career opportunity and welcoming environment, but will also be provided with a generous total compensation package with bonuses awarded in recognition of both individual and firm performance. Eligible employees can participate in Latham's comprehensive benefit program which includes:

- Healthcare, life and disability insurance
- A generous 401k plan
- At least 11 paid holidays per year, and a PTO program that accrues 23 days during the first year of employment and grows with tenure
- Well-being programs (e.g. mental health services, mindfulness and resiliency, medical resources, well-being events, and more)
- Professional development programs
- Employee discounts
- Affinity groups, networks, and coalitions for lawyers and staff

# Senior Marketing Manager

Location:USCompany:Oxalis Solutions

## Description:

Oxalis is building its marketing function from the ground up, and we're looking for the person who will own it. This role is for a marketing leader in a fast-growing technology and consulting firm with distinct and emerging business lines. You'll step into a company that has momentum and a clear strategy.

**What You'll Own**

- Lead execution across three marketing pillars: Industry Authority (thought leadership and SEO across a variety of industries), Partner-Powered Demand (Atlassian and IFS co-marketing, ABM), and Product Market Entry (YardOS GTM)
- Own the content engine — case studies, vertical guides, executive LinkedIn, conference content — built on the compounding model that's already proven in the maritime segment
- Run HubSpot as the measurement layer: pipeline attribution, lead scoring, campaign reporting to leadership
- Drive the YardOS demand generation motion: ABM, webinar series, roadshow coordination, and paid channel experiments
- Oversee direction of partner marketing activities
- Serve as a brand protector in all external marketing work through brand standards, messaging review, and GACCS brief governance
- Build a system that allows for greater investment in marketing activities

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

- Build and execute a marketing program that measurably supports Oxalis revenue and growth goals across all business lines
- HubSpot fully instrumented with closed-loop pipeline reporting
- Content library operational and actively used in sales conversations
- Principal amplification running — at least two execs with consistent LinkedIn presence
- A clear, data-backed 2027 marketing investment recommendation delivered to leadership

**What You Bring**

- 10 years in B2B marketing, ideally in technology consulting, SaaS, or a partner-driven business
- Proven demand generation experience — you've built pipelines, not just managed campaigns
- HubSpot fluency (admin-level experience strongly preferred)
- ABM experience with complex, long-cycle sales
- Comfort operating in a principal-led selling environment — you understand that in a firm like this, relationships close deals and marketing makes them possible
- Strong content instincts — you can tell the difference between content that compounds and content that evaporates
- Experience with partner co-marketing (Atlassian or IFS ecosystem a strong plus)
- Ability to work without a large team under you — you're the builder, not the manager of builders, at least initially

**Nice to Have**

- Maritime, defense, or federal IT vertical experience
- AI governance or GRC market familiarity
- Experience standing up a marketing function from early stage

**About Oxalis**

Oxalis is an Atlassian and IFS partner and technology consultancy with three business lines and ~$20M in revenue. We're in high-growth mode, we deliver for customers who can't afford to get it wrong, and we're building the internal infrastructure to match our ambition. This is a rare opportunity to own marketing at a firm that has the clients, the partnerships, and the product and just needs the leader.

Oxalis hires within defined regional hubs (Austin, PNW, Northern and Southern California, Chicago, New Jersey, National Capital Region). Candidates must live within the hub metro area. We are not a remote-everywhere company.

# Senior Marketing Manager (Memphis)

Location:Cloverdale, TNCompany:Executive Scouting

## Description:

A growing, well-established service-based company in the greater Memphis area is seeking an experienced Senior Marketing Manager to lead strategic marketing initiatives, strengthen brand awareness, and drive measurable business growth.

This individual will be responsible for developing and executing creative marketing strategies that increase visibility, generate qualified leads, build strong referral relationships, and establish a consistent pipeline of new business.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and hands-on marketer who thrives in a collaborative environment, understands relationship-driven marketing, and can turn creative ideas into measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and qualified lead generation.
- Drive a 40% increase in qualified inquiries within 12 months through targeted digital marketing, local SEO, content development, and referral campaigns.
- Build and manage a monthly content strategy, including articles, videos, social media, and community-focused campaigns.
- Develop and strengthen referral programs and strategic partnerships that generate consistent new business opportunities.
- Oversee the company's website, Google Business Profile, and digital presence to maximize traffic, engagement, and conversions.
- Plan and execute 4–6 community events, networking opportunities, or strategic partnerships annually.
- Manage external marketing vendors, including website developers, SEO specialists, graphic designers, and event partners.
- Track and analyze marketing performance, lead generation, conversion rates, and campaign ROI.
- Provide monthly reports to leadership highlighting marketing effectiveness, growth opportunities, and strategic recommendations.
- Collaborate with leadership and internal teams to ensure brand messaging remains consistent, engaging, and aligned with business objectives.

Qualifications

- Proven success in a senior-level marketing role, preferably within a service-based company or another relationship-driven industry.
- Demonstrated ability to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth through marketing initiatives.
- Strong understanding of local SEO, digital advertising, website optimization, and content marketing.
- Experience developing referral programs, community partnerships, and networking initiatives.
- Excellent writing, communication, and storytelling skills.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure marketing performance and optimize strategies.
- Experience managing external vendors, marketing budgets, and multiple projects simultaneously.
- Highly organized, self-motivated, and comfortable taking ownership of marketing initiatives from concept through execution.
- Ability to work closely with senior leadership and translate business objectives into actionable marketing strategies.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

- Strategic impact: Take ownership of marketing initiatives that directly influence business growth.
- Leadership collaboration: Work closely with key decision-makers who value creative thinking and measurable results.
- Growth potential: Help shape and expand the company's marketing function.
- Creative freedom: Bring fresh ideas to life and develop innovative marketing strategies.
- Community involvement: Build meaningful relationships and strengthen the company's presence throughout the greater Memphis area.
- Professional development: Opportunity to grow alongside an established service-based company with ambitious goals.

**Discover your future at Citi**

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

The Client Onboarding Sr Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

**Responsibilities:**

- Responsible for customer interaction, documentation issuance, review and system setups.
- Demonstrates high level of diligence, motivation and organizational skills.
- Focuses on timely and accurate delivery of all account opening functions, as well as delivering excellent customer service and resolution of customer issues.
- Performs day to day management of the account opening and maintenance processing, including daily management of in-process, pended, and service related activities, ensuring account opening requirements are clearly defined to support all scenarios of account opening and maintenance requirements, to include delivery of very high quality service to customers and internal partners.
- Responsible for various types of project management in the account services space, and managing cross-functional relationships with all teams.
- Determines new work procedures, analyzes complex and variable issues with significant departmental impact.

- Optimizes manpower to achieve higher productivity levels.

- Identifies means to reduce transaction defects (internal and external). Develops performance matrices to track defects, productivity.
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Qualifications:**

- 5-8 years of experience in documentation review, account Maintenance and related Cash products preferred.
- Good interpersonal communication skills. Able to communicate with internal and external business partners.
- Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated Project management skill including financial cost management skill.
- Advanced execution skills in a prioritization mode. Exposure to Customer Service and handling of system, testing and rollouts.
- Ability to achieve business objectives without compromising on controls and risk parameters established. Ability to interact confidently with senior management and / or regulators. Ability to coach and develop people, identifying and retaining talent. Able to partner with businesses and other support functions at senior levels in setting strategy and priorities. Able to strive under pressure and covert opportunity from risk. Should be open to working staggered hour /shift / over weekend and on public holidays. To ensure excellent rapport with internal stakeholders including peers and seniors and duly provide inputs to the team and ensure timely resolution of all issues, wherever there are business risks and the issues need to get addressed such cases should be raised to the senior's forum for appropriate action and advice.

- Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience

# Senior Digital Marketing Manager - Performance Marketing & SEO (Spanish Speaker)

Location:Tampa Palms, FLCompany:GEDU Services

## Description:

Job Description

**Senior Digital Marketing Manager - Performance Marketing & SEO (Spanish Speaker)**

\\n

\\n

**Tampa, USA (Onsite)** \| **Global Higher Education**

\\n

\\n

**This isn’t just another digital marketing role.**

\\n

We’re looking for a **senior digital marketing leader** who wants to **own growth—not simply manage campaigns.** You’ll lead the digital acquisition and organic growth strategy across Spanish-speaking markets, connecting **Performance Marketing, SEO, AI-powered search, analytics and conversion optimization** to one clear goal:

\\n

**Drive more qualified student enquiries, enrolments and sustainable growth.**

\\n

You’ll have the autonomy to **build the strategy, challenge the status quo, test new ideas and turn insights into action.**

\\n

\\n

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**

\\n

\\n

**Performance Marketing**

\\n

\\n Lead end-to-end campaigns across: **Google Ads • Meta • LinkedIn • TikTok • Bing**\\n Own **strategy, budgets, forecasting, audience targeting, creative testing, bidding, optimization and ROI** across the full student acquisition funnel.\\n From **awareness → consideration → conversion → remarketing → lead nurturing**, you’ll continuously identify opportunities to improve performance and lead quality.\\n\\n

\\n

**SEO & Organic Growth**

\\n

\\n Own the SEO strategy across: **Technical SEO • On-Page SEO • Content • Keywords • Link Building • Organic Acquisition**\\n Drive improvements across programme pages, landing pages, blogs and evergreen content while working closely with content, web and marketing teams.\\n\\n

\\n

**The Next Generation of Search**

\\n

Help shape how our organization is discovered in the evolving search landscape through:

\\n

**GEO • AEO • LLM Optimization • AI Search Visibility**

\\n

\\n

**Analytics, Conversion & Growth**

\\n

\\n Turn data into decisions through: **GA4 • Google Tag Manager • Search Console • Attribution • Conversion Tracking • Meta Pixel/CAPI**\\n Monitor **CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, Conversion Rate, ROAS, CAC and LTV** and translate performance insights into meaningful growth.\\n\\n

\\n

**WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT?**

\\n

\\n **You’ll have real ownership.** You won’t simply be handed a playbook and asked to follow it.\\n **You’ll be expected to create the playbook.** You’ll work across Marketing, Admissions, Content, Creative, CRM, Web Development and Regional Teamsto connect digital performance with the outcome that matters:\\n **More qualified students. Better conversion. Sustainable growth.** And because this is higher education, the numbers have meaning.\\n\\n

\\n

Behind every enquiry is someone making an important decision about their **education, career and future.**

\\n

\\n

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

\\n

You’ll be expected to deliver measurable growth, including targets such as:

\\n

\\n **+20–30% Organic Traffic**\\n **+15–20% Qualified Organic Enquiries**\\n **+20–30% Growth in Target Keywords Reaching Google’s Top 10**\\n **15–20 High-Quality Backlinks / Month**\\n **10–15 New Referring Domains / Month**\\n **+15–20% AI Search Visibility**\\n\\n

While continuously improving **ROAS, CPA, conversion rates and lead quality** across paid channels.

\\n

\\n

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

\\n

\\n **Seasoned professional with strong expertise in Digital Marketing is a must**\\n Strong expertise across **Performance Marketing + SEO**\\n Hands-on experience with **Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok & Bing**\\n Strong knowledge of **GA4, GTM, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs & Screaming Frog** or equivalent tools\\n Practical experience with **GEO, AEO and/or LLM Optimisation**\\n Strong analytical, commercial and strategic mindset\\n Experience with **conversion tracking, attribution, audience segmentation and marketing analytics**\\n Excellent stakeholder and communication skills\\n **Spanish fluency — essential**\\n **Professional English — essential** for internal communication and collaboration\\n Comfortable working in a **fast-paced, target-driven environment**\\n Higher Education, EdTech or lead-generation experience is an advantage\\n Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline is preferred\\n\\n

\\n

**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**

\\n

Join a **fast-growing global higher education organization** where digital is a key driver of international growth.

\\n

\\n

You’ll have the opportunity to:

\\n

✨ Shape international student acquisition strategy

\\n

Work at the forefront of **AI and next-generation search**

\\n

Directly influence measurable business performance

\\n

Build growth across Spanish-speaking markets

\\n

Collaborate with talented teams across marketing, admissions and technology

\\n

Help more students discover opportunities that can shape their future

\\n

\\n

# Business Office Manager

RiverPointe Post Acute

[Carmichael, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Carmichael%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6635338220012610811?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7192&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2688191835372271296&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Us**

RiverPointe Post-Acute is a premier provider of skilled nursing and rehabilitation services located in Carmichael, CA. We are committed to delivering 5-Star care through a team of experienced professionals dedicated to supporting patients in their recovery journey after surgery, injury, or serious illness. Our focus on compassionate care and medical integrity creates a nurturing environment for residents, their families, and our staff. By fostering meaningful connections within our community, we continuously adapt to the evolving needs of those we serve.

**Why Join Us?**

At RiverPointe Post-Acute, we are passionate about creating a supportive and empowering environment for our team members. Our culture prioritizes collaboration, flexibility, and work-life balance, ensuring you have the tools and opportunities to thrive both personally and professionally.

Our management team values understanding and compassion, making every effort to accommodate the unique needs of our employees. Here, you'll find a workplace that not only recognizes your contributions but also invests in your growth, well-being, and success and where you can make a difference every day.

**Position Overview:**

The **Business Office Manager** role is perform and/or supervise the collection of all accounts receivable, the input of billing information and the billing of Medicaid, Medicare, managed care, hospice, secondary, and other various claims, handle disbursements and collection of personal trust funds, and reconcile bank statements; and, other duties as assigned by the Administrator and AR Consultant.

- Supervision of billing and collecting resident accounting functions.
- Responsible for all aspects of the resident trust accounting system, including security of patient funds.
- Oversaw the patient billing system to ensure the accuracy of patient account billing information.
- Responsible for all patient-related accounts receivable balances including Medicare, Medicaid, Insurance, Private and Other Payers to ensure accurate balances, timely billing and collections.
- Responsible for front-end collections of A/R balances due from residents while in-house (met with residents and responsible parties upon admission and routinely thereafter to follow up on collections) and back-end collections of A/R balances due from residents after discharge.
- Manage the Medicaid pending application and conversion process to ensure timely resolution.
- Responsible for the month-end closing of the billing system in accordance with company policy and timelines.
- Responsible for timely processing of charges, adjustments, refunds, payment posting, and write offs.
- Ensures patient bills and collection letters are processed accurately and timely.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

- Previous experience as a Business Office Manager in a skilled nursing facility/long-term care for one year is a must.
- Collections and outstanding receivables experience strongly preferred
- Minimum or 1 year experience with Medicaid, Medicare, HMO, and other insurance billing and collections
- Point Click Care (PCC) billing system experience is preferred
- Strong knowledge of billing, and reimbursement processes in skilled nursing facilities.
- Excellent organizational and multitasking skills in a fast-paced environment.
- Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a team effectively.
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to interact with staff, residents, and families.
- Proficiency in healthcare software systems and Microsoft Office Suite.

**What We Offer:**

- Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage.
- Additional options like Accident Insurance and Hospitalization plans.
- Life and AD&D insurance included for full-time employees.
- 401(k) retirement savings.
- Paid time off: Vacation, Holidays, and Sick Leave.
- Supportive and collaborative work environment.
- Paid orientation and training programs.

We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related condition), age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), genetic predisposition or carrier status, military or veteran status, familial status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other status protected by law.

Administrative Coordinator – Engineering Technology Department – Solano Campus, California Polytechnic State University (Cal Poly)

Job Summary
Under general supervision from the Department Chair, the Administrative Coordinator is responsible for providing overall administrative and clerical support to the Engineering Technology department. Duties include implementing and evaluating administrative systems, directing student assistants, ensuring compliance with university and campus policies, coordinating faculty recruitment and onboarding paperwork, inputting course schedules, handling procurement and travel coordination, and managing a range of finance and faculty personnel transactions, including lecturer contracts.

Key Responsibilities

Provide administrative support to the department and collaborate with the broader College of Engineering administrative team.

Coordinate and implement uniform processes and procedures across departments.

Maintain continuity of administrative operations during Department Chair transitions.

Act as a liaison between faculty, students, and university services.

Handle financial transactions and faculty matters such as lecturer contracts and travel arrangements.

Support Solano campus Mechanical Engineering faculty scheduling, procurement, and event support.

Key Qualifications

Demonstrated customer service experience requiring a high level of diplomacy and professionalism.

Ability to use tact and diplomacy to handle sensitive interpersonal situations.

Ability to foster communication and teamwork in a diverse environment.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

Education & Experience

High School Diploma or equivalent; 45 wpm typing.

Five years of general office support or technical experience; or training at a vocational school or full‑time college education may substitute for two years of required experience.

Salary & Benefits
Anticipated Hiring Range: $52,404 – $67,788 per year. Classification Range: $48,696 – $79,836 per year. Full‑time, 1‑year temporary position eligible for full benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and CalPERS retirement.

Equal Opportunity Statement
This position is open and available to all regardless of race, sex, color, ethnicity or national origin. Cal Poly is an Equal Opportunity Employer in compliance with state and federal laws and is committed to ensuring every student and employee has access to the resources and support they need to thrive.

Description Optimus Property Management, Inc. ( a real estate investment and property management company based in Century City, CA, is seeking an Administrative Assistant to support daily office operations across our administrative, property management, and accounting teams. Working alongside our lead administrator, this role keeps the corporate office running smoothly, from front desk coverage and incoming shipments to tenant notices, property transitions, and expense coding.
This role is focused on organization, reliability, and follow-through. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable handling a wide variety of tasks in a fast-paced environment, and takes pride in being someone the team can count on.
Schedule Full-time, Non-Exempt, On-site
Requirements Provide administrative support to the Principal and executive team.
Answer calls, route inquiries, manage messages, and cover front desk duties as needed, including opening and closing the office.
Prepare documents for DocuSign, coordinate notaries, order office supplies, and manage incoming shipments and deliveries.
Handle office errands, including mail, package returns, event food pickups, and confidential shredding services.
Assist with property transitions, tenant welcome packages, notices, and related administrative tasks.
Prepare and distribute tenant notices, post Three-Day Notices, and process rent registrations and certificates of confirmation.
Process incoming rent checks.
Collect receipts and code American Express charges.
Save and organize loan statements in OneDrive using company naming standards and AI tools.
Ad hoc projects as assigned
Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree a plus
1+ years of administrative, office, or front desk experience preferred
Property management or real estate office experience a plus
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with DocuSign or RingCentral a plus, but not required
Comfortable learning new software, including AI tools, to work more efficiently
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Professional, friendly phone and in-person manner
Ability to manage multiple priorities and shift between tasks throughout the day
Valid California driver’s license, reliable transportation, and current auto insurance for local errands
Ability to lift up to 20 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation
Must be authorized to work in the United States

### Job Description

Job Description

**Medical Office Phone Representative — Medical Assistant Certification Required**

**Natomas Family Practice \| Sacramento, CA**

**Full-Time \| Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.**

**Pay: $20 -$22 DOE**

Natomas Family Practice is seeking a professional, organized, and dependable Medical Office Phone Representative to join our team. Our busy family practice receives a high volume of calls from patients and vendors. This position requires excellent customer service, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities while remaining calm and courteous.

**Medical Assistant certification and Epic EHR experience are required.**

**Responsibilities**

- Answer and manage a high volume of incoming calls with professionalism, courtesy, and efficiency.
- Schedule patient appointments according to practice guidelines and provider availability.
- Receive, accurately document, and route prescription refill requests, patient questions, and other requests to the appropriate team member.
- Communicate provider-reviewed results, instructions, and follow-up recommendations to patients as directed.
- Document all patient communications thoroughly and accurately in Epic.
- Coordinate with providers, medical assistants, and front-office staff to ensure timely responses and follow-through.
- Handle vendor calls and direct inquiries appropriately.
- Protect patient confidentiality and follow practice policies.

**Required Qualifications**

- Current Medical Assistant certification.
- Experience using Epic EHR.
- Strong telephone communication and professional customer service skills.
- Ability to handle multiple calls, tasks, and priorities in a fast-paced medical office.
- Excellent organization, attention to detail, and thorough documentation skills.
- Ability to work effectively under pressure while maintaining accuracy and a courteous manner.
- A solution-oriented approach, dependable follow-through, and a team-player attitude.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

You understand that every call matters. You can listen carefully, identify what is needed, document clearly, and follow through while managing a busy phone queue. You are dependable, adaptable, and committed to providing patients with a positive experience.

**To Apply**

Please submit your resume highlighting your Medical Assistant certification, Epic experience, and relevant medical-office or high-volume phone experience.

# Executive Assistant

$68k - $72k

Napa Valley Community Housing

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7296227290533577537?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2752272724297781409&crId=US_0US_0)

The mission of Napa Valley Community Housing is to develop, preserve and manage affordable homes

Job Description
Summary:

Napa Valley Community Housing is seeking a highly organized critical thinker to be its Executive Assistant, partnering with the organization’s CEO to stay in control of a busy schedule with competing priorities. The Executive Assistant will take ownership of the CEO’s calendar and work with her to prioritize internal and external obligations. Acting as a project manager, the EA will shape the CEO’s workflow, tracking progress of high-stakes tasks, deliverables, and meetings for the organization’s leadership, external partners, board of directors, and elected officials.

While the position’s priorities and focus will be meeting the needs of the CEO, the Executive Assistant may be responsible for assisting other senior staff with administrative tasks. With a direct line to the CEO, the Executive Assistant has a unique opportunity to help shape the organization’s culture and path forward.

A successful candidate is a clear communicator with a professional demeanor, calm under stress, and able to make decisions and shepherd tasks and projects with minimal oversight. The ideal candidate anticipates the CEO’s needs, is tenacious and accountable.

Responsibilities

Own the CEO’s calendar, scheduling meetings according to priorities as established in collaboration with CEO

Prepare draft agendas and take minutes as required during team, management, executive, and board meetings

Track meeting follow up items, raising potential delays and roadblocks to the CEO’s attention as necessary

Assist in planning team, management, and board events and offsites, taking ownership of event logistics

Perform receptionist duties as a backup to the organization’s part‑time administrative assistant

Light facilities duties, including managing facilities vendors, stocking office and kitchen supplies, and coordinating repairs and maintenance on behalf of the CEO

Light office administration, including tending to incoming mail, photocopying, scanning, and similar tasks

Skills and Competencies

Strong communication skills, written and verbal

Excellent attention to detail with a tenacious ability to perform effective follow‑ups

Demonstrated ability to multi‑task and effectively navigate competing priorities on behalf of executive leadership

Experience communicating directly with boards of directors and executive‑level staff

Superior software skills with the ability to learn new tools quickly

High regard for confidentiality; ability to handle sensitive and urgent matters discreetly

Experience with the nonprofit sector

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in a similar role

Bilingual Spanish is a plus

Vehicle required with possession of a valid California Driver’s License, a good driving record and automobile insurance per requirements of the State of California

Additional Information
Based on experience the annual salary is $68,000 - $72,000

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Job Description Meals on Wheels Orange County is the largest nonprofit provider of nutrition and supportive services for at-risk older adults. It is committed to erasing hunger and loneliness for at-risk older adults through nutritious meals, friendly visits and safety checks, and keeping families together through day services. Through its critical services, the organization delivers nearly 2 million meals to 20,000 at-risk older adults each year throughout Central and North Orange County. Meals on Wheels Orange County is a dba of Community SeniorServ, Inc. Hours: Mon-Fri, 5:00 am-1:30 pm Entry Level Position: Rate varies depending on experience Location: Anaheim, Ca We are excited to share the hourly range for this position is $21.00 - $23.00 per hour, exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at MOWOC, your final compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience in addition to internal pay. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth.
JOB SUMMARY: The Production Administrative Coordinator supports the Food Services and Sales Department by coordinating menus, surveys, training materials, reports, billing, inventory documentation, and day-to-day administrative needs. This role is ideal for an organized, detail-oriented professional who enjoys supporting teams, improving processes, and contributing to programs that serve clients and community partners.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Coordinate surveys, menus, nutrition education materials, temperature sheets, and in-service training materials for Home Delivered Meals, Congregate Sites, and Commercial programs.
Prepare reports, correspondence, billing, statistical data, and program documentation with accuracy and professionalism.
Enter and maintain menu and food service data and support monthly physical inventory processes.
Support kitchen staff, drivers, Site Managers, the Registered Dietitian, purchasing, and department leadership with administrative and operational needs.
Assist with special projects and other duties as assigned.
QUALIFICATIONS:
High School Diploma plus 5+ years of administrative support and/or customer service experience.
Proven advanced Microsoft Office skills and strong attention to detail.
ERP systems experience preferred; ability to learn food service data systems required.
Strong organization, follow-through, communication, and ability to work independently.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Regularly sit, stand, walk, use a computer, keyboard, and phone, and communicate in person or by phone/email.
Occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull office supplies, files, materials, or boxes up to 25 pounds.
Frequently go in/out of freezers/refrigerators as needed to complete essential duties and responsibilities.
Must be able to perform duties in an office and food service administrative environment with reasonable accommodation as needed.
Meals on Wheels Orange County is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive work environment.
