The Front Desk Receptionist is responsible for greeting patients, answering telephone calls, gathering and inputting patient data, collecting payments, scheduling visits, obtaining records, and other administrative tasks for the Los Angeles Cancer Network (LACN). This role will provide support for the front office area and serve as the initial interaction between the patient and LACN.
**Essential Functions:**
The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time with reasonable accommodations.
Daily
Review and triage schedule
Collect and input patient demographic information into their G4, if changed
Verify for Each Patient Daily: Insurance, Home Address, Phone Number, emergency contact CareSpace, Pharmacies (patient preferred and LACN Pharmacy must be listed), Advanced Directives (dated current year), and most recent Insurance Card Scanned.
Check co-pay sheet, IOD copay collect required payments throughout the day.
Prepare patient identification wristbands.
Warmly greet patients, check them in, and room patients appropriately.
Answer phones, check voicemails, and monitor text messages.
Check: Group inbox, CareSpace inbox, Task inbox Email, Microsoft Teams, Relatient, Website Inquiries, Faxes, and other communication modalities.
Assist with the coordination of patient care, calling specialists, imaging centers, and external facilities as needed. Document accurately.
Schedule patient visits, reschedule visits, cancel visits, and call patients back for any missed appointments. Attempt to reschedule any canceled/no-show visits same day.
Assist with patient forms- disability, FMLA, etc.
Maintain the cleanliness of your station. Ensure no protected health information is left out.
Update and move Saturday orders.
Log out of all systems and computers before the shift ends.
Prepare mail and co-pays for pick up (if applicable).
Ongoing
Complete training on time, as assigned.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
Demonstrates exceptional assessment, critical thinking, and customer service skills.
Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.
Ability to seek out resources independently and work collaboratively.
**Education and Experience:**
High school diploma or equivalent
Current CPR certification.
Basic computer knowledge.
Previous Oncology/ Hematology experience (preferred)
**Additional Requirements:**
Must be able to sit or stand for long periods of time, with occasional walking.
Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
Able to travel to satellite clinics when necessary.
Must be willing and able to lift up to 25 pounds.
Salary Transparency: Exact compensation may vary based on skills, education, certifications, experience, and location. Base Salary Range: $23.00 to $25.00 per hour.
Location: The Valley Region. May require traveling to other satellite offices.

**Now Hiring: Front Desk Coordinator**

**Dogtopia of Sacramento – Nimbus Winery**

Love dogs and connecting with people? Join our pack! We’re looking for a friendly, organized, and dependable Front Desk Coordinator to help create an exceptional experience for our pet parents from their first inquiry through every check-in and pickup.

This role focuses on customer service, lead follow-up, scheduling, and front desk operations. You’ll introduce families to Dogtopia, explain our services and pricing, and help pet parents choose the right options for their dogs.

**What We Offer**

- The opportunity to bring your dog to work after successfully completing training and meeting eligibility requirements
- A fun, supportive team environment
- Competitive wages and flexible scheduling
- Career advancement based on performance
- Training and additional certification opportunities
- Hands-on experience in customer service, sales, communication, and business operations

**What You’ll Do**

**Welcome Pet Parents & Manage Check-Ins and Pickups**

- Greet every pet parent with warmth and enthusiasm.
- Check dogs in and out accurately and efficiently.
- Review reservations, care instructions, and account notes.
- Communicate pet parent requests and updates to the appropriate team members.
- Process payments and help resolve account or billing questions.

**Follow Up with Leads & Explain Our Services**

- Follow an established lead contact schedule through phone calls, texts, and emails.
- Answer questions from prospective pet parents and help schedule Meet & Greets.
- Clearly explain daycare, boarding, spa services, pricing, packages, and wellness plans.
- Help pet parents find services that fit their dog’s needs and their schedule.
- Follow up after Meet & Greets to answer questions and encourage enrollment.
- Document conversations and next steps so every inquiry receives timely follow-up.

**Keep Records Accurate & Organized**

- Create and update pet parent and dog profiles.
- Contact veterinary offices to request and verify vaccination records.
- Review records for completeness and notify pet parents of missing or expiring vaccinations.
- Manage appointments, reservations, and data entry with attention to detail.
- Keep account notes and follow-up tasks current.

**Support a Welcoming Front Desk**

- Answer phone calls, emails, and messages professionally.
- Keep the lobby and front desk clean, organized, and inviting.
- Become familiar with retail products and current promotions.
- Communicate concerns to management and help ensure pet parents receive timely answers.
- Work closely with the team to keep daily operations running smoothly.

**What We’re Looking For**

- A friendly, outgoing personality and a love for dogs
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Confidence discussing pricing, explaining services, and following up with potential customers
- Excellent organization, accuracy, and attention to detail
- The ability to prioritize tasks in a busy environment
- Comfort using computers, answering phones, and learning new systems
- A dependable team member who takes initiative and follows through
- Customer service, reception, or sales experience is a plus

**Our Dogtopia Values**

- We **LOVE** life unconditionally like a dog.
- We **STAY** loyal to our pack.
- We **CHASE** the absolute highest standards of safety.
- We **PLAY** to our fullest potential.
- We **TREAT** every day like It’s the Most Exciting Day Ever!

**Ready to join our pack? Apply today and help us build lasting relationships with our dogs and their families!**

Dogtopia of

Sacramento – Nimbus Winery & Land Park

As much as we’d like to spend all day with our dogs, it’s not always possible. Dogtopia of Sacramento – Nimbus Winery and Dogtopia of Land Park is your one-stop shop when you are looking for a safe and fun place to leave your pup when you can’t be with them. We are the premier destination for dog daycare, boarding and spa services. Our mission is to make sure your four-legged family members have a fun time when they stay at our fully equipped, spacious facility.

Accounts Payable Specialist
Company: Richwell Group
Location: City of Industry, CA
Employment Status: Non-Exempt
Compensation: Starting at $22.00 -$25.00 per hour
Reports To: Accounting Manager

About Richwell Group
Richwell Group is a meat and seafood manufacturer located in City of Industry, California. We are seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Accounts Payable Specialist to join our accounting team and support the day-to-day financial operations of the company.

Position Summary
The Accounts Payable Specialist will be responsible for managing the company’s accounts payable activities, including processing invoices, verifying supporting documentation, maintaining accurate vendor records, and assisting with timely payments. This position requires strong attention to detail, organization, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

The Accounts Payable Specialist will report directly to the Accounting Manager .

Essential Responsibilities

Process and accurately code vendor invoices and accounts payable transactions.

Review invoices for accuracy, appropriate approvals, and supporting documentation.

Match invoices with purchase orders, receiving documents, and other applicable records.

Enter invoices and payment information into the accounting system.

Reconcile vendor statements and research discrepancies.

Communicate with vendors regarding invoices, payment status, and account discrepancies.

Prepare and process payments in accordance with company policies and payment schedules.

Maintain organized and accurate accounts payable files and documentation.

Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.

Assist with account reconciliations and other accounting duties as assigned.

Monitor outstanding invoices and help ensure timely payment of obligations.

Maintain confidentiality of financial and vendor information.

Work closely with purchasing, receiving, and other departments to resolve invoice and payment issues.

Support the Accounting Manager and accounting team with special projects and administrative duties as needed.

Qualifications
Required

2+ years of accounting experience , preferably with accounts payable experience.

High school diploma or equivalent required; accounting coursework or an associate degree is a plus.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information.

Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.

Preferred

Previous experience in a manufacturing, food production, distribution, or related industry.

Experience with an ERP or accounting software system.

Experience with three-way matching and vendor statement reconciliations.

Work Environment
This position is primarily an office-based accounting role located at Richwell Group's manufacturing facility in City of Industry, California . The employee may interact regularly with purchasing, receiving, operations, vendors, and other departments.

Compensation & Employment

Starting Pay: $22.00 per hour

Employment Classification: Non-Exempt

Reports To: Accounting Manager

Compensation may be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Richwell Group is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. We value a diverse and inclusive workplace and make employment decisions based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs.

Position Summary The Assistant Accountant is an experienced accounting professional with a strong understanding of accounting principles and practices. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and macros.
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to prioritize responsibilities, manage multiple tasks, and consistently meet deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Positive attitude, strong initiative, and the ability to build collaborative relationships and contribute to the Accounting team's success.
Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for improvement.

Maintain accurate and timely timekeeping records in Paychex.

Possess sufficient manual dexterity to operate office equipment, handle documents, and perform routine clerical tasks.
Occasionally lift and move objects weighing up to 20 pounds.
Perform occasional filing duties that may require bending, standing, reaching, or accessing filing cabinets.
Possess sufficient visual and auditory capabilities to perform essential job functions, including computer work and office communications, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Work Environment Work primarily in a well-lit, climate-controlled office environment with adequate ventilation.
Routinely use standard office equipment, including computers, telephones, printers, photocopiers, and filing cabinets.
Experience moderate noise levels typical of an office environment, including conversations, telephone calls, and group activities.

# Wholesale Marketing Project Coordinator

Arrowmac

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2813653825460920879?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7160070560479421939&crId=US_0US_0)

Join our client’s vibrant team as a Wholesale Marketing Project Coordinator and help shape the future of effortless, coastal-inspired fashion that resonates with women nationwide. If you thrive in a fast-paced, creative environment and have a knack for connecting trends with impactful marketing, this is your chance to make a real difference in a brand built on quality, community, and style.
**Overview:**
As the Wholesale Marketing Project Coordinator, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving our client’s growth through innovative wholesale marketing strategies. Working closely with company leaders and cross-functional teams, you’ll lead the development and execution of initiatives that increase market share, elevate brand awareness, and foster meaningful relationships with retail partners. This is a dynamic role perfect for a proactive, organized professional ready to bring ideas to life and help this brand shine through the busy holiday season and beyond.
**Requirements:**
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred
3+ years of wholesale and/or retail marketing experience required
Experience working with a fashion brand required
Experience with Asana, Figma, and Adobe Creative Suite a plus
Experience with managing budgets and building decks preferred
Creative thinker and up to date on emerging marketing trends
Excellent project management skills with flexibility to switch between multiple projects

About Us: Located in the heart of Del Mar, L’Auberge is an award winning, luxury resort overlooking the Pacific Ocean from one of Southern California’s most picturesque coastal Villages. Estate-style guest rooms and suites, a full-service spa, dreamy dining options, tennis courts and an inviting ocean-view pool are just a few reasons why you would be proud to work here!
The Job: As the Operations Coordinator, you will work closely with the Housekeeping and Engineering departments of the hotel. The Operations Coordinator must be a highly motivated individual who is eager and ready to accept additional responsibilities when needed. This person should demonstrate exceptional customer service and problem-solving skills.
**Responsibilities include, but not limited to:**
Process invoices for Housekeeping and Engineering
Champion Alice system, our guest request program
Coordinate projects
Log and follow up on guest requests
Support reservations team
You: To be successful in this position, we're looking for an amazing people connector, who thrives on creating experiences and multi-tasking. This role requires skills such as patience, empathy, efficiency and a desire to work in, and provide, a clean environment.

Fluency in both English and Spanish is required
Ability to stand and walk for extended periods of time throughout the property, including back-of-house and outdoor areas
Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds occasionally
Ability to bend, kneel, reach, push, and pull as needed to support operational tasks
Ability to climb stairs and access various levels of the property
Ability to sit at a desk and work on a computer for extended periods of time
Manual dexterity to operate office equipment, computers, and handheld devices
Ability to visually review documents, computer screens, and work orders with attention to detail
Ability to respond quickly to operational needs in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work in various environmental conditions, including indoor and outdoor settings
Ability to tolerate moderate noise levels typical of hotel operation
Our Culture: The Noble House Hotels & Resorts philosophy emphasizes “location, distinction and soul.” Our properties are not a “one-size fits all”. And neither are our team members. What makes L’Auberge Del Mar so special lies within our Team. We are a group of individuals that share a passion for hospitality. People who best fit are sharp, trustworthy team players. We let our personalities shine and we enjoy having fun!

401K Plan with Employer Match
Onsite Complimentary Parking
Free Meals in EDR
Team Member/Family/Friend hotel and restaurant discounts within Noble House Hotels & Resorts
Career growth opportunities and recognition programs

# Intake Service Coordinator

San Gabriel Pomona Regional Center

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-483850081278133375?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8816841010699916430&crId=US_0US_0)

The Organization San Gabriel/Pomona Regional Center (SG/PRC) is a private, non-profit agency that is contracted with the State of California, Department of Developmental Services (DDS) to provide services and supports to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. We proudly serve 30 cities across the Foothill, Pomona, and El Monte Health District within Los Angeles County. Our services span the full lifespan from infants and toddlers, school-age children, and transition-age youth to adults and aging adults. At SG/PRC, our work is guided by compassion, collaboration, integrity, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful difference in the lives of the individuals and families we serve.
The Position Under the general direction of the Early Start Manager, the Intake Service Coordinator collects information, records, and assessments pertinent to determining whether an applicant for services has a condition that demonstrates eligibility for early intervention, provisional eligibility or for Lanterman Act services when applying California Code of Regulations Title 17, United States Code of Federal Regulation 34, and the Lanterman Act. When needed, if existing records are insufficient to make an eligibility decision, the Intake Service Coordinator, through coordination with the applicant for services or their legal representatives, will secure medical, occupational therapy, physical therapy, psychiatric, autism, neurology, psychological or behavior health treatment assessments to support the multidisciplinary review process to reach an eligibility decision.
Essential Job Functions Assists applicants and families with the regional center eligibility and admissions process.
Meets with applicants and their families, explains the eligibility criteria, explains services offered by the regional center and conducts a family interview.
Participates in the multidisciplinary team process in making decisions related to adaptive behaviours and provisional eligibility.
Supports the coordination and scheduling of developmental or psychological evaluations and medical consultations with contracted clinicians.
Gathers information and reviews applications to determine if assessment is warranted with understanding of co-morbid conditions.
Prepares and presents cases at eligibility team reviews held with contracted psychologists, physicians, and families.
Obtains any previous evaluations/assessments for purposes of determining the applicant’s admission for services.
Collaboratively works with clinical consultants and outside agencies to reach an informed decision about the applicant’s admission into regional center services.
Works with an interdisciplinary team to provide generic resources and recommendations for eligible and ineligible applicants.
Participates in interdisciplinary meetings with other clinical staff, as needed.
Coordinates aspects of case management as applicants and their families move through the admissions process.
Monitors individuals assigned through the admissions process.
Complies in meeting mandated timelines
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Requirements Employment Standards A bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, human services or other related fields.
Two years’ case management experience.
Master's degree in a related field can be substituted for the required experience.
Bilingual in Spanish is preferred.
Other Essential Requirements A valid driver's license, reliable transportation and minimum liability insurance coverage is required.
Knowledge and Abilities Knowledge of developmental disabilities and available community resources.
Knowledge of interview, counseling, crisis intervention, and behavior intervention techniques.
Ability to independently plan, organize, and schedule work effectively.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to multitask, establish priorities, and manage competing responsibilities.
Ability to complete accurate documentation and meet strict documentation timelines.
Ability to interact effectively and respectfully with individuals from diverse cultural and social backgrounds.
Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Microsoft Word and Outlook.
Ability to develop, implement, and adapt individualized service and support plans based on individual needs.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documentation and case management.
Ability to conduct in-person meetings and collaborate effectively with individuals, families, and other stakeholders.
Ability to provide compassionate, culturally sensitive support while maintaining professionalism and confidentiality.
Physical Demands & Work Environment Work 60% of the time in an office environment and 40% in the community at meetings or home visits.
Ability to drive to and from meetings or home visits and walk from car to and from appointments.
Occasional walking and standing to attend and participate in office meetings and trainings.
Ability to sit for extended periods and operate a computer for report writing.
Clear verbal communication in person and by phone.
Occasional lifting, pushing, or pulling of items up to 25 pounds.
Adequate visual acuity to read documents, use computer monitor for prolonged periods, and review detailed information.
60% of the work time occurs in a typical office setting with standard lighting, temperature, and moderate noise levels.
Employees are expected to follow safe and ergonomic work practices.
Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

##### General Summary

Under supervision, this position is responsible for assisting with coordinating labor, equipment, materials, trucking and rentals for all construction projects for assigned location to ensure project appropriate resources are allocated.

##### Essential Job Accountabilities

- Assist in coordinating project resource needs with the Construction Manager, Superintendents, Safety, and Equipment departments to ensure project schedule goals are met.
- Communicate detailed information such as time and specific locations to dispatch resources to jobs in the field to ensure appropriate resources are allocated.
- Arrange and work with the Equipment department and other area dispatchers to ensure the best opportunity for Granite equipment utilization; schedule equipment repairs as needed.
- Utilize computerized dispatch and distribute on a daily basis to communicate resource and scheduling with team.
- Communicate dispatch to Superintendents so that they can monitor daily work (QC, Shop, PM, Payroll).
- Work with various vendors to ensure Granite receives the best possible pricing for rentals or other materials needed that are not already set in job setups; utilize the FIS system in order to streamline the processes, including setting up rental equipment and export to Field systems.
- Understand and know contract requirements when it comes to ordering job resources (DBE, listed companies or special Tier compliant equipment).
- Update the underground service alert (USA) to ensure it is current.
- Code dispatch office invoices to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
- Depending on location track rentals and equipment moves.

- Ability to abide by Granite's Code of Conduct on a daily basis.
- A team player.

# Public Safety Dispatcher

Viejas Casino & Resort

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7675143192581339400?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7174914255790190922&crId=US_0US_0)

Job Summary
Acts as the link between the Security Department, general public, Team Members and public safety agencies. Responsible for receiving, dispatching, and logging all request for security assistance and monitoring radio’s, alarms, and outside camera in order to detect crimes or disturbances, protecting Tribal assets, and providing a safe environment for guests and team members.

Job Description

Screens incoming telephone calls for requests for, Police, Fire, and Medical Emergency Service assistance as well as for non-emergency, administrative and Enterprise business requests; directs incoming calls to the proper officers/units.

Receives and dispatches requests for services from outside public safety agencies, Tribal Government and Tribal Government departments, San Diego County Animal Control, vendors, contractors, towing services, and locksmiths.

Receives all calls for medical assistance from Team Members or members of the community, processing such calls for nature and severity of medical emergency.

Coordinates and dispatches appropriate medical resources, relaying pertinent medical information on the patient to responding personnel.

Provides pre-arrival instructions in accordance with policy to ensure safety of patients, bystanders, and responding personnel.

Monitors emergency radios for traffic directed to the Communications Center.

Dispatches calls for service to proper officers/units and assists units in handling the requests.

Using a Computer Aided Dispatch (CAD) system, monitors and updates officer/unit location and status, prioritizes calls for service, and monitors pending calls.

Logs all criminal history and driver’s history as requested.

Monitors alarms and notifies proper units, or other personnel, of any alarm activation or other problems.

Observes the exterior premises of the casino and parking lots on closed circuit television monitors to detect crimes or disturbances, protects Tribal assets, and assists in ensuring the safety and welfare of guests and team members.

Assists guests and the public at the front counter with general inquiries and lost and found property.

Learns and maintains knowledge of officer policy and procedures; the methods of handling difficult public contacts; the operation of telephone console and/or central communications equipment; rescue and emergency response procedures; Federal, state, and local laws and ordinances; terminology and jurisdictional boundaries; and available types of emergency services.

Learns and maintains knowledge of the general geography of the Casino, Outlet Center, and Reservation, including but not limited to Reservation boundaries, surrounding jurisdictions, street numbering system and primary highways and roads.

Learns and maintains knowledge of the radio codes and signals in the Viejas Tribal Security and Radio Code Book.

Learns and maintains knowledge of telephone interview and information gathering techniques to ensure the rapid and accurate collections and dissemination of required information.

Observes and reports to supervisor any criminal activity, disturbances, suspicious persons, or violations of Casino policies and procedures.

Maintains required activity logs and equipment logs pertaining to Security Department.

Acts with discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive information; required to sign and adhere to a confidentiality agreement.

Ensures that a clean, safe, hazard-free work environment is maintained.

Adheres to all company and department policies, procedures, and standard operating guidelines.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Does not provide supervision to other team members.

High school diploma or general education degree (GED).

Possess a valid driver’s license and maintain a satisfactory driving record.

California Responsible Beverage Service Training required upon hire.

Must be age 21 years of age or older.

1 to 2 years of experience in the operation of a telephone switchboard or communications equipment; or

1 year of general office work involving extensive public contact either in person or over the phone; or

Completed Post-Certified Basic Complaint/Dispatcher course or equivalent combination of training, education, and experience.

Must have the ability to communicate clearly, effectively and professionally in the English language, including the ability to write reports that can be understood by the CEO, COO, General Manager, Tribal Council, legal staff, court officers, and law enforcement.

Ability to type 35 wpm (a skills test is required).

Knowledge of basic computer and phone skills.

Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, including a pleasant and courteous voice, good enunciation, and excellent hearing skills.

Ability to communicate with people of diverse social and cultural backgrounds.

Ability to establish and maintain working relationships with other agencies.

Ability to speak Spanish or another second language preferred, but not required.

Ability to retain and relay information received under stressful conditions, respond to calls quickly and calmly and make sound decisions under pressure.

Ability to multitask while paying attention to details.

Ability to adjust and manage change effectively.

Ability to resolve problems as they arise and handle situations without supervision.

Possess a high degree of common sense.

Must be able to deal with emergency situations, and work well under pressure.

Ability to work in a professional high-pressure environment while demonstrating and maintaining good personal relation/people skills and a positive attitude.

Ability to multitask and work well under stress.

Must be a self-starter and able to adjust to change.

Must be able to work flexible hours during the day or evening including weekends, holidays, and all blackout dates.

Hiring Preference
The Viejas Band of Kumeyaay Indians is an equal opportunity employer. Consistent with tribal and federal law, the Viejas Band of Kumeyaay Indians applies Native American preference in hiring.

Hello There Collective

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

Hello There Collective is a female-led creative agency based in Los Angeles, specializing in a 360-degree approach to brand building in the digital space. We work with brands across beauty, wellness, fashion, and lifestyle, delivering performance-driven influencer, content, and social media strategies.

We’re seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Influencer Marketing Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you’ll gain hands‑on experience managing influencer campaigns from start to finish, working closely with our talented team to bring brands’ stories to life through creator partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Coordination – Support the execution of influencer marketing campaigns, including outreach, influencer communication, deliverable management, and timeline tracking.

Content Management – Organize, track, and manage influencer content submissions, ensuring all assets align with brand guidelines and deliverables.

Reporting & Analytics – Assist in tracking campaign KPIs (engagement, reach, impressions) and compiling performance data into actionable reports.

Relationship Management – Maintain clear, friendly, and professional communication with influencers to foster authentic, long-term partnerships.

Administrative Support – Help with contracts, invoicing, and other administrative tasks to keep campaign workflows running smoothly.

Qualifications

1+ year of experience working on influencer marketing campaigns (agency or in-house)

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

A keen eye for aesthetics and understanding of different brands’ influencer needs

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and thrive in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment

Familiarity with influencer platforms, social media tools, and industry trends is a plus

Why Join Us

Be part of a dynamic, female‑led creative agency

Gain exposure to influencer marketing across multiple industries

Work with a collaborative team passionate about driving real results for brands

Opportunity to grow within a fast‑paced, creative environment

# Marketing Manager

THE HEIGHTS CASINO, INC.

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5393473582914209182?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-912932554553937220&crId=US_0US_0)

Summary of Position: Responsible for the development and execution of the Cher‑Ae Heights Casino Marketing plan, Guest Relation strategies and programs within the Marketing Department and its sub‑departments of Player’s Club/Gift Shop, Player Development, Executive Casino Hosts, Entertainment and Events, Graphic Design, Advertising and Social Media by performing the following duties personally or through department supervisors and leads.
Responsibilities: Establish, execute, monitor, and adjust strategic marketing plans, both short and long range, to achieve Casino objectives regarding revenue, profitability, and market share.
Statistically analyze marketing programs and adjust strategy and tactics to increase effectiveness to meet changing market and competitive conditions.
Provide performance reports, analysis, and regular status reports on marketing programs to the Management Team and Tribal Council.
Effectively cooperate and coordinate activities (such as events and promotions) with other managers to ensure interdepartmental team relationships.
Research, analyze, and monitor financial, technological, and demographic factors to capitalize on market opportunities and Gift Shop.
Ensure inventory control; report current stock on hand and necessary purchasing orders for gift shop supplies and inventories with the Crown Club/Gift Shop Lead.
Ensure effective controls of marketing results and take action to guarantee that marketing objectives fall within designated budgets.
Plan, prepare and present for approval advertising and promotional materials and negotiate all media buys and publicity.
Coordinate public relations while working with city and state organizations to promote casino interest, initiate press releases and represent the casino at appropriate functions.
Maintain close working relationship with media.
Manage the development, production, and distribution of promotions and collateral materials including print, social media, direct mail, point‑of‑purchase displays, and signage to support sales and marketing programs.
Monitor competitive products and marketing activities.
Oversee development, maintenance and utilization of customer database (Kanomi).
Establish research methodology such as survey, opinion poll, or questionnaire, and design means for collecting data for each project.
Develop and assist in conducting surveys and focus groups to analyze customer purchasing patterns, preferences, and the organization’s image and marketing effectiveness.
Negotiate entertainment contacts with local bands for entertainment venues.
Create an atmosphere of fun for all casino guests.
Set a positive example at all times for all team members.
Maintain a professional reputation within the Marketing Departments, the company and the community.
Serve as Public Information Officer and spokesperson for The Heights Casino and the Indian Community of the Trinidad Rancheria.
Required Qualifications: High school diploma and Bachelor’s Degree, Masters Degree (B.A. or B.S.) and/or equivalent experience.
Five to seven years Casino Marketing/Advertising experience and the ability to handle a high‑volume, fast‑paced environment.
In‑depth knowledge of advertising, promotions, entertainment design, special events, direct mail and player tracking systems.
Ability to interact with the general public.
Work Environment and Physical Demands: Working environment consists of various levels of smoke, noise, light, heat, and cold.
Must be able to respond to visual and aural cues.
Must be able to operate in physically and mentally stressful conditions.
Must have the manual dexterity to use a computer keyboard, micr‑touch screen and phone.
Conditions and Policies: The Heights gives hiring preference first to members of the Trinidad Rancheria and then to members of all other federally recognized tribes.
All candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a valid Tribal Gaming License once employed.
All candidates are subject to pre‑employment drug screening. Once employed, all employees are subject to random drug and alcohol screening.
This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with the job. The Heights reserves the right to make changes to the job description.

Droyd Robotics

**About the Team**

Droyd builds autonomous robotic systems that automate repetitive manual work in real environments. We design and manufacture our hardware in-house, which means iteration, fabrication, and execution all happen under one roof.

As we grow, the office and shop need to run smoothly so the team can stay focused on building. Our environment includes engineering, hardware, demos, travel, and day-to-day logistics - good office operations have a real impact on team effectiveness.

**About the Role**

As Office Manager at Droyd, you will own the day-to-day logistics of keeping the office running. You will help manage facilities, travel, supplies, and general workplace operations so the team can move quickly.

This role is ideal for someone dependable, organized, and proactive about making physical operations run well.

This role is based on-site in San Francisco, CA.

**In This Role, You'll**

Office & Facilities

- Manage day-to-day office logistics and facilities needs
- Coordinate supplies, deliveries, and workplace organization
- Help maintain a clean, organized, and effective working environment

Vendors & Logistics

- Work with vendors, cleaners, and other service providers
- Help book travel and support team logistics

Team & Visitor Support

- Support office readiness for visitors, meetings, and demos
- Anticipate operational needs before they become blockers

Work Environment & Schedule

- On-site in San Francisco, CA
- Full-time

**We're Looking For Candidates Who**

- Are highly organized and reliable
- Are comfortable juggling logistics and shifting priorities
- Communicate clearly and work well with both internal teams and outside vendors
- Are proactive and take ownership of operational details
- Thrive in a fast-moving startup environment

**Nice to Have**

- Experience in office management, workplace operations, or administrative roles
- Experience supporting in-person teams in hardware, startup, or technical environments
- Experience with travel coordination, facilities, or vendor management

**About Droyd**

Droyd builds autonomous robotic systems that operate in real production environments. We design the hardware, develop the control stack, and generate the data that enables generalist robotics.

If we do this right, robots stop being demos and start being infrastructure.

Join us and help build the systems that make it real.

About Berkeley
At the University of California, Berkeley, we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom and belonging make it a special place for students, faculty and staff.
As a world-leading institution, Berkeley is known for its academic and research excellence, public mission, diverse student body, and commitment to equity and social justice. Since our founding in 1868, we have driven innovation, creating global intellectual, economic and social value.

Departmental Overview
Berkeley Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, University Extension, and Osher Lifelong Learning Institute (SSALLEX) is the trusted educational provider for students at all stages of their academic and professional journeys. A vibrant, inclusive, and dynamic organization, SSALLEX welcomes 60,000 visiting, current, and potential Berkeley students studying across a wide range of programs, including year-round courses, Fall Program for Freshmen, post-baccalaureate programs, visiting student experiences, study abroad programs, global internships, summer minors, professional certificates, and year-round offerings for older adults. Via Licensing Alliance

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7291647615148595084?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8080197495822275299&crId=US_0US_0)

## Office Administrator

Join the leader in collaborative licensing and help us advance inclusive and efficient new patent licensing approaches to drive innovation globally. Via Licensing Alliance is dedicated to accelerating global technology adoption, fostering participation, and generating return on innovation with balanced IP licensing solutions for innovators and manufacturers of all sizes around the globe. Via administers dozens of patent licensing programs in audio, video, broadcast, power, and more for a variety of technologies, consisting of 25,000 patents in over 130 countries, with nearly 100 current patent holders and over 3,000 current licensees.

Via Licensing Alliance, a subsidiary of Dolby Laboratories, is an independently managed company owned by industry-leading participants with over 25 years of intellectual property licensing leadership. We are the world's largest patent pool administrator. We aggregate patents around key innovations and offer licensing solutions that give companies streamlined access to standardized technologies. For decades, we have served as a trusted bridge between our licensors and licensees, driving a strong and efficient IP licensing environment that yields better products and technologies for people around the world.

The part-time Office Administrator manages the daily administrative functions for the San Francisco office. This position requires a comprehensive understanding and execution of activities, responsibilities, and interactions to facilitate seamless administrative operations. The Office Administrator receives visitors and provides general administrative, organizational, and communicative support to all Via San Francisco based staff. The Office Administrator will work closely with the Dolby Places Team and will be the main point of contact for the regional office. This non-exempt, part-time role requires to work in the San Francisco office three full days per week (Tuesday-Thursday).

Key Responsibilities

Plan for, budget for and manage day-to-day activities of the San Francisco office. Seek out assistance requests from other departments. Manage office reception, mail, messenger services, FedEx, internal mail and the scheduling of conference rooms.

Receives visitors while maintaining the upmost security of the Via suite, also provides refreshments and notifies the appropriate parties of all incoming visitors.

Provide administrative support to senior leaders as needed, including travel coordination, expense reporting, presentation preparation, and other related administrative tasks.

Maintain the inventory of office supplies and non-IT office equipment, furniture, plants, art work and other assets.

Provides administrative support for all staff, including:

Coordinate weekly lunches for the San Francisco staff and on-site and off-site social events.

Communicate/Distribute incoming correspondence.

Arrange for outgoing correspondence or packages.

Arrange meeting and conference calls as requested.

Assist with mass mailings.

Organize files; email filing as needed.

Handle various administrative requests.

Receiving and prioritizing mail and shipments.

Supplying and conducting inventory of kitchen.

Ensures the proper ordering and maintenance of all office supplies and groceries.

Maintains the order and appearance of the San Francisco office.

Maintains the order of the kitchen.

Maintains office equipment and contacts vendors for necessary repairs.

With direction from the Dolby Places Team, help coordinate building improvements, repairs, maintenance, parking assignments and office moves for the San Francisco location. Help to manage off-site and on-site storage as needed. Obtain janitorial and other office maintenance services as requested.

Receives, logs-in and distributes invoices and mail to the appropriate departments.

Manage and perform special projects as requested by other departments.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Skills

Relevant prior work experience in professional office environment

Professional and positive attitude

Detailed knowledge of administration practices

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office business applications, especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook

Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills

Detail oriented with ability to work well independently and ability to organize and manage multiple priorities

Professional maturity, discretion, and cooperation in dealing with people at all levels inside and outside the Company.

The San Francisco/Bay Area hourly base pay range for this part-time position is $32.00 $41.00 per hour and can vary if outside of this location. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, competencies, experience, market demands, internal parity, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and perks and benefits for your location during the hiring process.

$38 - $45 per hour

Nibbi Brothers General Contractors

Nibbi Brothers has been a member of the Bay Area’s construction community since 1950. The Company is known for its integrity, innovation, quality and contributions to the communities in which it works. Nibbi’s safety program often exceeds federal and state requirements, demonstrating that the safety and wellbeing of everyone associated with our projects is the highest priority. Core markets include commercial, civic, seismic retrofits, historic restoration, waterfront structures, education, housing, hospitality, and community-based facilities. Nibbi self-performs production framing and structural concrete. Our projects range in size from $5 million to over $200 million.
Nibbi provides its people with comprehensive benefits and opportunities for career development. We encourage continuing education at all levels. We are proud of our friendly, family culture that is based on respect, collaboration and a strong work/life balance.
Position Summary This is a key support role for Nibbi’s Safety and Quality departments. This position is responsible for compiling, organizing, and formatting data from various internal sources to generate accurate and timely reports. The role also assists in maintaining compliance documentation , improving internal reporting processes, and supporting daily operational needs through general administrative tasks . The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and capable of handling confidential information with discretion.
This is a full-time, non-exempt position. This position reports to the Vice President of Safety and Health and the Director of QA/QC.
Work location: San Francisco office.
Essential Functions Support Safety and QA/QC Departments with preparation of reports and data management.
Provide administrative support to the Vice President of S&H and the Director of QA/QC.
Ensure work product is prepared with a high level of accuracy, while meeting required deadlines.
Successfully manage a broad array of responsibilities with excellent time management and organizational skills.
Represent Nibbi in a professional manner.
Responsibilities Gather data from field reports, inspections, audits, and Safety and QA/QC meetings.
Prepare and distribute regular Safety and QA/QC incident tracking reports, logs, and other performance indicators.
Maintain organized and up-to-date documentation for compliance, regulatory filings, and internal audits.
Assist in drafting or updating standard operating procedures (SOPs), and Safety or QA/QC bulletins.
Assist with presentations, executive summaries, manuals and strategic planning.
Maintain confidentiality in handling sensitive information and executive communications.
Create and refine report templates, tracking sheets, and forms to enhance workflow efficiency.
Collect and synthesize verbal updates and written reports from team members to produce summaries and action lists.
Coordinate interdepartmental data collection to support safety, quality, and strategic reporting initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and recommend or implement enhancements.
Assist with planning annual safety events.
Qualifications Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Construction Management, or related field preferred, or equivalent work experience in the construction industry
3+ years of experience in an administrative, reporting, or data coordination role—construction, safety or quality assurance/control industry experience strongly preferred
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook; experience with reporting tools or construction software (e.g., Procore, Buildr) is a plus
Strong communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to synthesize information clearly
Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
Ability to maintain discretion and confidentiality in support of executive leadership
Familiarity with safety and quality standards in the construction industry is an asset
Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee, with or without reasonable accommodation, to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:
Sit for long periods of time.
Look at a computer monitor for extended periods.
Use hands and fingers.
Reach with hands and arms.
Some local travel to project sites, meetings and special events may be required.
Nibbi offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible spending plans
Life and supplemental insurance
401(k) with employer match
Paid time off and holidays
Incentive compensation bonus
Educational reimbursement
Student loan repayment assistance
Generous maternity and paternity leave policy
The expected compensation range for this position is between $38 and $45 per hour, depending on experience.

## Join Levi Strauss & Co.

Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit and your future.

We are seeking a Front Desk Receptionist to join our team at the LS&Co. corporate office in San Francisco. You will be the first point of contact for employees, visitors, and vendorsmaking a lasting first impression and helping maintain a smooth and welcoming front office environment.

### About the Job

- Welcome employees, visitors, and vendors warmly and professionally.
- Issue visitor passes and follow security protocols.
- Escort visitors to meet with employees, ensuring they reach their destination safely and efficiently.
- Answer inquiries and provide information about office services and amenities.
- Keep the reception area clean and organized, and coordinate with internal teams as needed.
- Provide event support as needed, including setup and coordination.
- Support and work with the security team to ensure safety and compliance.
- Offer general office front desk support, such as managing mail, scheduling appointments, and assisting with administrative tasks.
- Hours: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PST, with occasional flexibility required.
- You will report to our Facilities Manager.

### About You

- Previous experience in hospitality, front desk or customer service.
- Communication Skills: Excellent verbal communication skills.
- Customer Service: Strong interpersonal skills and professionalism.
- Organization: Attention to detail and ability to multi-task on several tasks at once.
- Ability to resolve issues and handle unexpected situations.

The expected starting salary range for this role is $60,800-$80,000 per year. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range based on the location of the role. The amount a particular employee will earn within the salary range will be based on factors such as relevant education, qualifications, performance and business needs.

Levi Strauss & Co. (LS&Co.) offers a total rewards package that includes base pay, incentive plans, 401(k) matching, paid leave, health insurance, product discounts, and more designed to help you and your family stay healthy, meet your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. Available benefits and incentive compensation vary depending upon the specifics of the role; details relating to a specific role will be made available upon request. Read more about our benefits here.

LS&Co. is an affirmative action and equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome and value people from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences to make LS&Co. a collective success.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require current or future employment visa sponsorship. The company does not participate in the H-1B cap lottery or sponsor initial employment visas. Candidates with an existing H-1B visa that is eligible for transfer may be considered.

## Receptionist San Francisco, CA

Assignment Duration: 1 month + Hours: 7:30-4:30 (with 1 hour lunch break)

Why is this role open? Coverage Possible for extension? TBD Interview process: 1-2 virtual interview

### Day to Day Tasks:

First point of contact for all those entering the facility. Greet them with a friendly and welcoming demeanor. Issue visitor and parking passes and follow security protocols.

Make a memorable first impression by answering the telephone in a professional manner. Create presentations and speak to various-sized groups.

Arrange and confirm recreational, dining, and business activities on behalf of the requestor.

Manage janitorial or maintenance work orders as needed. Coordinate and execute workplace services including mail, office supply services, and onboarding.

Acknowledge inquiries or complaints from employees, guests, and co-workers. Provide solutions in a professional customer service-driven manner.

Organize and manage on-site events. This includes securing event space, set up and tear down of the room, and delivery of supplies.

Follow property-specific security and emergency procedures. Notify appropriate parties to ensure the safety of all individuals in the building.

Coordinate with vendors who supply services or goods to the workplace.

Explain detailed and/or complicated information within the team. Follow specific directions as given by the manager.

Impact through clearly defined duties, and methods and tasks are described in detail. Use existing procedures to solve straightforward problems while having a limited opportunity to exercise discretion.

Resetting chairs, wiping surfaces

General assistance with office upkeep

### What You'll Need:

High School Diploma or GED with up to 2 years of job-related experience.

Ability to follow basic work routines and standards in the application of work.

Communication skills to exchange straightforward information.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.

Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.

$25 - $30 per hour

Zacks & Freedman, PC

### Job Description

Job Description

Description:

**San Francisco, CA \| Full-time \| Hourly, nonexempt**

**Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. \| Fully in-person**

**Compensation: $25–$30 per hour, depending on experience**

**About the Position**

Zacks, Freedman & Chernev, PC is seeking a dependable and service-oriented Legal Receptionist & Client Services Coordinator for our San Francisco office.

You will serve as the first point of contact for clients, prospective clients, attorneys, vendors, and other visitors. You will manage incoming calls, support the firm’s client-intake process, and help keep daily office operations organized.

This position suits someone who communicates professionally, exercises sound judgment, and stays organized while managing frequent calls, visitors, and competing priorities.

**What You Will Do**

- Greet clients, visitors, and vendors and provide a professional office experience.
- Answer, screen, and route incoming calls promptly and accurately.
- Gather preliminary information from prospective clients using established intake procedures.
- Record and distribute complete, accurate, and time-sensitive messages.
- Prepare and reset conference rooms for client meetings and firm events.
- Receive, sort, and distribute mail, deliveries, and legal documents.
- Scan, file, and organize electronic and physical records.
- Enter expenses and other information into the firm’s practice-management system.
- Monitor office and kitchen supplies and coordinate replenishment.
- Provide administrative support for attorneys and staff as needed.
- Protect confidential client, employee, and firm information.

Requirements:

**Preferred**

- Experience in a law firm, professional-services firm, or other client-focused office.
- Experience answering a multi-line telephone system.
- Experience with client intake, data entry, or practice-management software.

Legal experience is helpful, but we encourage applicants with transferable experience in professional services, hospitality, healthcare, property management, or another client-facing environment to apply.

**What We Offer**

- Hourly compensation of $25–$30, depending on relevant experience.
- Eligibility for a discretionary bonus.
- Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
- Paid time off and paid holidays.
- 401(k) profit-sharing eligibility after one year of employment.
- Training and professional-development opportunities.
- Opportunities to develop experience in client intake, legal administration, and law-firm operations.

**About the Firm**

Zacks, Freedman & Chernev, PC is a San Francisco law firm dedicated to protecting Bay Area owners' property rights. We value professionalism, responsiveness, collaboration, and dependable client service.

_Zacks, Freedman & Chernev, PC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law._

# Executive Assistant

$100k - $140k

Metric Bio

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6102461841681797939?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=826847217689812768&crId=US_0US_0)

Metric is partnering with a well-funded, venture-backed life sciences technology company building a platform designed to change how researchers study human biology and disease. They’re backed by top-tier investors and are scaling quickly as they move their technology toward market.

They’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support the CEO and CSO directly, with secondary support for the broader leadership team. This is not a reactive calendar role. You’ll be the person who keeps leadership running: preparing executive briefs ahead of key decisions, orchestrating board and investor meetings, and making sure priorities stay on track against company deadlines. The team has budget for, and a strong bias toward, automating manual work. Someone who builds systems instead of just maintaining them will stand out.

What you’ll own

Calendars, inboxes, and task tracking for two executives, including resolving conflicts and coordinating high‑stakes internal and external meetings

Executive briefs and deadline tracking so leadership makes informed decisions

Advisory, board, investor, and all‑hands logistics, covering invitations, vendors, and documentation

Domestic and international travel from start to finish

Personal scheduling for executives, plus periodic office support

What they’re looking for

2+ years in a high-intensity environment such as investment banking or a hypergrowth startup

Strong judgment and discretion, and composure when priorities compete

Real fluency with modern productivity and AI tools. Experience building inbox rules, automations, or agents is a big plus

Willingness to handle time-sensitive requests outside standard hours

Exceptional communication and attention to detail

Bonus: a biology or chemistry background, or experience supporting a CEO through fundraising or diligence

Why this one is different
You’ll have direct access to leaders at the edge of biological discovery and full visibility into how a company sets its priorities and operating cadence. The team rewards outcomes over years of experience, and you’ll get regular, direct feedback.

$100K to $140K base, plus stock options

100% medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents

401(k) with employer contributions

Generous PTO and paid parental leave

Hybrid in the East Bay, so candidates should be within commuting distance

## Executive Assistant To The CEO

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent's "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.

To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.

We're backed by Greylock & Bain Capital Ventures, and we've built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

- Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo
- Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase
- World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler
- Preeminent research labs like Deepmind and SAIL

### About the Role

We're hiring an Executive Assistant to the CEO to own the operations behind our CEO and Field CISO so their time goes where it has the most impact: customers, candidates, and building the company. You'll be their partner in running the week, planning ahead and keeping every commitment on track, with the trust to make calls on your own.

### What You'll Do

- Own calendar and email management for both executives end to end, from triaging inbound requests to protecting focus time across time zones
- Coordinate their weeks: prep for meetings and follow up on action items until they're done
- Run logistics for critical meetings, including candidate conversations with our CEO
- Host customers, investors, and candidates visiting our San Francisco office, and serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office
- Handle the day-to-day logistics for leadership, including travel and team meals through Forkable
- Take on special projects as they come up, and expand your support to our founders and critical function leaders as the team grows

### What We're Looking For

- 7+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, ideally supporting a CEO or founder
- Background at a venture-backed startup or a venture capital firm
- You've done this job before and can run on day one: you anticipate what the CEO needs and act on it before being asked
- Advanced calendar and inbox management, with the judgment to decide what gets time and what gets declined
- Strong project management skills - you keep several workstreams tracked and moving at once
- Poise with customers and executives, and comfort being the first person a Fortune 500 security leader meets at Cogent
- Discretion with confidential information

### Bonus Points

- Experience supporting more than one executive at a time
- Experience coordinating recruiting logistics or candidate interviews
- Experience at a Series A-C company during a period of fast headcount growth

### Job Description

Job Description

**Job Title: Executive Assistant**

**Location: San Francisco, CA**

**Duration: 13 weeks**

**Shift: Day 5x8-Hour (08:00 - 17:00)**

**Job Description:**

**Requirements:**

- Experience as an Executive Assistant supporting senior executives
- Strong calendar management experience, including complex executive calendaring
- Experience coordinating meetings for large groups and multiple stakeholders
- Ability to work with other Executive Assistants and administrative support teams
- Proficiency in scheduling, meeting coordination, and executive communication
- Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint
- Ability to maintain a polished, executive-facing presence
- Ability to work onsite full time at CPClient Van Ness Campus

**Preferred Requirements:**

- Hospital or healthcare administrative experience
- Experience supporting C-suite or senior leadership

### Job Description

Job Description

**Accounts Receivable Specialist II**

Role Summary

Are you an experienced finance professional with a sharp eye for detail and a passion for operational accuracy? We are seeking a dedicated **Accounts Receivable Specialist II** to join our accounting team for a 6-month assignment (with the possibility of extension or permanent conversion)!

Reporting directly to the Controller, this role is responsible for executing full-cycle accounts receivable functions across multiple organizational entities using Oracle. You will maintain precise financial transaction records, create and post customer invoices, process incoming payments, and manage collection workflows. By reconciling subledgers, resolving billing inquiries, and optimizing key performance metrics like Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), you will play an essential role in safeguarding financial health and supporting overall organizational growth. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy leveraging data systems to solve problems, this position offers an inspiring opportunity to advance your accounting career!

Duties & ResponsibilitiesAccounts Receivable Operations

- Execute full-cycle accounts receivable processing for assigned accounts across all organizational entities.

- Generate and distribute accurate, timely customer invoices utilizing Oracle, including processing invoicing for organizational donations.

- Process, apply, and post incoming customer payments via check, ACH, and electronic wire transfers.

- Conduct regular follow-ups on delinquent customer accounts and resolve billing discrepancies directly with customers.

- Reconcile the Accounts Receivable subledger to the General Ledger on a regular and routine basis.

- Investigate and resolve customer inquiries, billing disputes, payment discrepancies, and credit memo issuance.

- Prepare comprehensive AR management reports, including aging schedules and analytical cash performance summaries.

- Administer AR operations in alignment with key performance indicators, focusing on reducing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), improving cash application timeliness, and minimizing delinquent balances.


General Accounting & Departmental Support

- Assist leadership with the preparation of annual tax returns and month-end closing procedures.

- Support internal and external audit requests by retrieving and verifying requested financial documentation.

- Review incoming credit applications as assigned.

- Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining accounting policies, business workflows, and internal controls.

- Perform other related accounting duties and projects as assigned.


Required QualificationsEducation & Experience

- **Education:** Associate’s Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field (a High School Diploma or GED may be considered in lieu of an Associate’s degree).

- **Work Experience:** Minimum of five (5) years of progressive, hands-on experience in Accounts Receivable.


- **Software Requirement:** Hands-on experience and proficiency with **Oracle** ERP systems (Required).


- **Accounting Principles:** Strong understanding of foundational accounting principles, subledger reconciliation, and financial processing.

- **Data Handling:** Analytical proficiency using data manipulation tools such as Microsoft Excel.

- **Accuracy & Speed:** Excellent data entry speed and precision.

- **Communication & Service:** Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with a strong customer service orientation.

- **Organization & Time Management:** Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, manage strict deadlines, and solve problems independently in a fast-paced environment.


Desired Qualifications

- **Advanced Degree:** Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance.

- **Industry Background:** Prior experience performing accounts receivable functions within the healthcare or human services sector.


Location and Work Type

- **Work Type:** Full-Time Contract Position (40 hours per week; 6-month assignment with possibility of extension or conversion; Hourly rate range: $33.00 – $39.00 per hour).

- **Work Setting:** Hybrid Model (2 to 3 days per week on-site, remaining days remote).

- **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week (with occasional evening or weekend hours required as business needs evolve).

- **Physical & Travel Requirements:** Ability to lift up to 10 lbs. occasionally; willingness and ability to travel occasionally between local regional office facilities.

# Project Coordinator

$72k - $85k

Pendulum™

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5345471944453841571?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=426&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3181739030520299785&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**About Pendulum**

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin.  We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health.  Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome.

Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a  unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale.

The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company  earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list.

If you’re interested in improving the lives of people globally and you love working in a cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for an organized, proactive Project Coordinator to join our Product team. You'll work closely with the Program Manager to keep projects moving, supporting Supply Chain and other cross-functional initiatives such as supplier onboarding, packaging changes and new product launches. You'll be the person who keeps the details in order: agendas drafted, files organized, deliverables tracked, and issues flagged early.

We’re looking for someone who’s energized by the pace and possibility of a fast-growing, mission-driven company. You thrive in a collaborative, nimble environment where ideas are shaped through iteration, feedback, and shared vision. You’re not just a big thinker—you’re also a creative problem-solver who knows how to make things happen with limited resources. If you're excited by the opportunity to help shape a young brand from the ground up, and passionate about building something with purpose, you'll feel right at home here.

What You'll Do

- Support day-to-day coordination and management of Supply Chain and other cross-functional projects, including supplier onboarding, packaging changes and new product launches

- Draft meeting agendas, capture notes and action items, and distribute follow-ups

- Monitor daily progress on project deliverables and flag risks, delays, or blockers to the Program Manager

- Maintain project documentation, keeping files, trackers, and shared folders organized, current, and easy to find

- Update project plans, timelines, and status reports

- Schedule meetings and coordinate availability across internal teams and external partners

- Work cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Finance, Product, and Marketing

- Serve as the main point of contact between team members and the Program Manager.

- Draft and update SOPs and checklists as workflows change

- Help run project kickoffs and retrospectives, and capture lessons learned

- Help identify opportunities to improve project processes and templates.


What You’ll Need

**Experience**

- 1-3 years of experience in project management in operations, supply chain, procurement or a similar role

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

- Comfort working with data in spreadsheets (sorting, filtering, formulas, lookups)

- Proficiency with Google Workspace


**Skills**

- Organization: Multitasking and managing daily details across multiple workflows

- Communication: Clear verbal and written updates for stakeholders and teams

- Time Management: Keeping fast-moving tasks aligned with deadlines

- Technical Proficiency: Using scheduling frameworks (like Gantt charts), spreadsheets, and project management tools


Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting product launches or supplier/vendor onboarding

- Exposure to supply chain, procurement, or consumer products

- Familiarity with ERP or inventory systems (such as NetSuite) or purchase order workflows

- Medical, Dental, and Vision
- Commuter Benefits
- Life & STD Insurance
- Company match on 401 (k)
- Flexible Time Off (FTO)
- Equity

**Financial Operations Coordinator PMOUNTJP00001257**

- Hourly pay: **$40/hr**
- Worksite: Leading digital streaming network (San Francisco, CA 94107 - Onsite)
- W2 Employment, **Group Medical, Dental, Vision, Life,** **Retirement Savings Program,** **PSL**
- 40 hours/week, 9 Month Assignment

A leading digital streaming network seeks a **Financial Operations Coordinator** to support the end-to-end procure-to-pay cycle, from purchase requisition through invoice processing, while serving as the primary point of contact for vendor onboarding and issue resolution.

**Financial Operations Coordinator** **Responsibilities:**

- Process invoices and create purchase orders (POs) as the primary daily responsibility, supporting the end-to-end procure-to-pay cycle from requisition through invoice processing.
- Manage purchase requisitions, PO creation and amendments, and invoice matching and reconciliation.
- Assist with vendor management and direct vendor communications, serving as a point of contact for vendor onboarding and issue resolution.
- Work across multiple systems daily, including the ERP system's procurement and payables modules, a vendor management system, internal ticketing, Slack, and email.
- Use Excel and manage multiple open requisitions and tickets, prioritizing accurately under deadlines.

**Financial Operations Coordinator** **Qualifications:**

- 1-3 years of experience in financial operations, procurement, or accounts payable.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration is preferred.
- Hands-on experience with ERP system Procurement and Payables modules.
- Experience managing purchase requisitions, PO creation/amendments, and invoice matching.
- Familiarity with vendor management systems (Graphite or a comparable VMS).
- Comfortable working across multiple tools daily, including ERP, ticketing systems, Slack, and email.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly with invoice/PO reconciliation.
- Experience in a high-volume or multi-entity procurement environment is preferred.
- Prior experience with vendor onboarding/compliance workflows is preferred.
- Basic understanding of GL coding and budget-to-actual tracking is preferred.
- Oracle Fusion experience is preferred.

**Shift:**

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
